If read, the etchings reveal a song about a criminal held in confinement for killing a noble, but her jailhouse was besieged by bandits for a year. After the first verse, the faint chiseled etchings become deeper and clearer, telling of the dwarf’s temporary release and subsequent victory in combat of the besiegers alongside her jailers. The third and final verse is carved faintly and carefully again, detailing the dwarf continuing her life sentence until her death.

1rhWn9mVdDHSsvsH.description: An ivory tusk the length of an arm but carved with scenes from a battle long ago.

egGBJpJvV7wyqHgj.description: A polished brass and copper clockwork toy of a small cottage, a farmer and their animals that moves when wound.  The farmer chases a toy chicken with an axe.

cp1YiJNm74qVVhvL.description: A scrimshaw pipe. When puffed on small skeletal animal smoke shapes rise out.

icEdO5MQOiTEoggG.description: A white porcelain chamber pot, the much-maligned last work of a great artist who went mad. The pot has the signature of the artist scrawled on it in a shaky hand.

Yp47bcF0ODrN9XgC.description: A painting that was started but not finished that depicts a beautiful landscape. It was started by a famous painter but unfortunately, he died halfway through finishing it. Parts of it are still sketched while others are fully painted.

weYYV5OXmkpLTnQm.description: A tiny sundial made from a single piece of platinum.

X5XmoqqkiSKpyrvw.description: This ornate oak chair is both artsy AND functional. Sculpted by talented elven Craftsman as a wealthy dining set but have been split up due to war. Each chair depicts a different scene in a major war that happened thousands of years ago.

eN5L0EFaPoNjGrSs.description: A small, ornate hand-mirror, with decorative trim and a quote running along the edges that reads ‘Beauty is Diligence in Physical Form’.

KVfZVgFTtQoEKCO7.description: a painting with a mage shouting spells, it is clearly readable out of his mouth, but the letters become denser and denser until it’s only black paint.

Lp3R8dDjyVhMDSnt.description: A portrait that makes a 3d bust illusion of a designated person. Requires a simple ritual to ‘take the picture’.

SUeib8Z1C6NQLPH6.description: A mirror that makes you look more attractive via illusion magic.

ho41qtopXfDYeE8v.description: A vase made from beautiful stone, carved with celestial figures around it, some marble inlays

eevt3JFUbsKX91Ql.description: A silver circlet with a glowing stone in it, it can be used to cast light once per day

dKA1F4ltsqPrJHLY.description: An abstract art piece, not of any notable artist, but painted with specks of stones with permanent and colorful illumination.

V5hFaZRTUz6yuZ1N.description: An ornate mantle clock that rings the hour with twelve separate melodies.

S5b22eydHZgOaSjY.description: A boldly colored quartz the size of a pigeon’s egg, etched and painted in such a way that when it is placed to one’s eye in the light, they see a clever but naughty image of a beautiful person in the nude.

J3AjNRDH4l8RP04m.description: A wood bound codex filled illuminated with several hundred pages of highly colorful and anatomically difficult descriptions of sexual positions.  The codex is sealed with a small brass chain.  The text of the manuscript is in a language that is not common.

Yyr3FCbbMDbvSAdx.description: A disk of clay with extremely fine etchings of semi-concentric lines that seem to spiral outwards from the center in tight, semi random wiggly spirals.  It has been broken into three shards.

hRr4gIreA2lybdDV.description: A hat-stand made with ornate knobs of polished brass on the ends of the hooks.  The knobs are animal heads in fine detail.

VRic6UhfGPwDBWjM.description: A desktop ornament made of pink clear glass in the shape of a pig with a bright red glass apple in its mouth.  When the pig is rubbed, it makes a magical oink noise.

UB7rMpe10P8xNmNk.description: An ornate, decorative inkpot and penknife made of rare animal horn.

hEceJFzqinW5tvXu.description: A wire basket handled rapier of ornate design, with a fake ruby made of glass mounted in the pommel.  The rapier is mounted to be a trophy on a wall.  A small plaque reads, ‘Wrath’.

vEpXpBecRZ3fxUM9.description: A large globe showing the known world and a nested set of platonic solids, all made of brass.  The entire contraption is over a meter across.

gT6bKoVU1Crc6PIC.description: A palm sized gelatinous cube containing a finely crafted model ship. The cube has been permanently suspended in animation with magic and is non-threatening.

vXbfdtI0psL6gPQW.description: A painting of a flail snail enhanced by magic to project faint rainbow light from the shell of the flail snail.

vUqc9rVh6NT1s9Ch.description: a handcrafted dreamcatcher adorned with werewolf teeth

6pqIBeZi5gZAWN2o.description: The mask of a cloud giant. The mask is pearl white and has light pink stripes.

iZcsH7y5JA6yY1Ap.description: A sentient, immobile, carved basalt statue of a jellyfish, summoned to godhood by a cult of Koa-Toa

jH9rzDiFnQRpSlqs.description: Silver Body chains, worn by a high priestess Yuan-Ti.

uLkYuePaIvaAcy42.description: A mind flayers brain kept inside of a glass container.

uDFEQwWBuoOk7TfF.description: A perfectly preserved molt of a Yuan-Ti Abomination. The molt is displayed on a large wooden platform.

5A37paOrBSuzVRyC.description: A gnomish tinkered hummingbird that fly’s in place for eternity.

Z2sluTEuUtVrrCPv.description: A palm sized jade turtle. While visibly impressive, most appraisers know it is of sub-par craftsmanship.

FrEKy0uqhstra5XZ.description: A glass display with the first 100 gold coins minted by a nearby dwarven civilization.

sNroDxGBNmqSbCQZ.description: A display of a stone giants stone club. far too heavy to wield by medium sized creatures.

fL4FxSlokf6DXVdZ.description: A grey ooze that has been polymorphed into a throw rug. The ooze is unable to move across the floor on its own, however is constantly moving ‘within’ itself, giving the appearance of a swirling void.

agE3pSmH9bJHy11a.description: A palm sized carved stone replica of the Tomb of Horrors.

yc0ENNKYhta0pl5M.description: A single Coatl feather, on a palm leaf.

veBMXDiD9ufzp4KA.description: A perfectly preserved bone skull of a Sahuagin, on a corral wall mount

u1UQDPnkIJBnRfyf.description: The wrappings of a mummy inside a locked trunk.

gUzBXPkE7daSwA5j.description: A small living carnivorous plant, inside of a notably larger iron cage.

UJvdSklemCzg4gfH.description: A carved golden sun, meant to mounted on a wall

AofiKCcJybuz7mUs.description: A stone tiled gameboard. the gameboard has stone figurines of adventurers fighting goblins in a dungeon.

VKXBNzNwVTLghqn3.description: A painting of a ship sailing away from Waterdeep bay.

xoxHOYgfFKbMhB74.description: A carved tusk of an unknown monster, depicting druids in the middle of a ritual

SkTEErERzkT3w3QP.description: An ornate, smooth orb of hardened tree sap (mixed with lavender dye.) It has the appearance of a round translucent ball (the size of a tennis ball in real life) with a dark purple hue and is often mistaken for an old family heirloom. Perhaps an Eboron spell wright believes it is her great grandmother’s spell casting focus, passed down for generations, or is a rather loud-mouthed, malicious constable found in his office every morning adoring his magnificent paper weight with an unusual amount of quiet glee?

VgYL3HZqW1sFL3vD.description: A singular wooden box, with 1-year worth of every spice in the world.

wMPqG1pbsGQjeX2K.description: A non-magical stone ‘official’ seal carved of three birds in flight with a blank spot where the buyer’s official crest can be added.

Jas8vxLYYGnMUQDx.description: Six ornately decorated candles with religious symbolism, and tapers (for lighting), in a small, smoked boxwood case of fine craftsmanship, with space for a seventh candle.

BEFtUnqHWMjugmm3.description: A brass and glass hand-mirror with an intricate wirework for the handle.  The wirework is of a bird in a cage.

EVyzYxz2dZv51js2.description: A polished brass telescoping spyglass, compass, octant, and slide rule set with precisely engraved markings and extreme precision.  It comes in a velvet lined wooden case that has been treated with beeswax.

eEaRP6b21cPZKKd8.description: A gilded oil lamp with ornate scrollwork cutouts of a warrior, and an evil sorcerer, meant to cast shadows on the wall in their shape.

tk1kjWyY1kGd2ZOq.description: A fine glass lensed magnifying glass tied by a red silk ribbon to a codex filled with hundreds of pages of detailed illumination regarding the natural world.

y23tJSoOvWNCFXSL.description: The Fall of Cavour: A Fictional Piece about the caveman wars.

iCjMtiB0nVAFIxqf.description: What Men know about Women: A Hard cover Book with One Hundred Empty Pages.

0rC1QOykrYN7N5Yb.description: Friar Albert’s Guide to Forest Trails: Lichen and moss, you fool. Learn the difference.

hQHKaD1XMaMB9UFG.description: Friar Albert’s Guide to Brewing: You should probably not be adventuring while doing this.

K87jridHpsrWQx77.description: Friar Albert’s Guide to the History of [setting]: Braggins be quiet and pay attention!

H07FfdiLKXW9788z.description: Friar Albert’s Guide to Herbs and Plants: If you can’t remember this then chew on some hemlock for your nerves.

WJiipsEbMOGuXn8l.description: Friar Albert’s Guide to Publishing Law: No I can’t be held responsible if you only read the byline and then die.

Wb4xLZJvCFmbiXCl.description: Friar Albert’s Guide to Fleeing the Academy and Hiding in a Church Cellar: A Memoir.

IJuAciTMbY2MIBwS.description: Beholder in the eye of Beauty: Classic fashion tips for the beholder in your family!

jTF95SEG4o5IwzCg.description: Maps, Maps, Maps: Tons of maps for your reading pleasure.

mO9S19X1HcnfiGn0.description: The Lusty Argonian Maid: A classic Tamriel tale of a lusty lizardfolk maid.

qhSaKDvZWgbblBb9.description: Dr. Harding’s Guide to Magic Science: Dr. Harding’s book describes how magic is a hoax to supress scientific explanations of the supernatural.

vkWQFSSPS0qHfkz5.description: Dungeon Masters and how to find them: mysterious book describing the seldom-seen beasts.

JhBAR4HYVOGfRYY5.description: A Monster’s Guide to Secret Lairs: Everything a monster needs to know about making the perfect home.

TmEOVcGLMLhkVpAP.description: The Faerun Survival Guide [1st edition]: Written (and illustrated by) St. Moyra of Bron Abbey as the complete reference for would-be adventurers or visiting celestials. Written by a recluse and based on what had been told to the author by word of mouth, it contains many “facts” that should probably not be followed.

xPLsGmb8saZdzShx.description: Behind The Wall: A book made out human skin. This book is constantly wet and smells like a fresh corpse. This book talks about a seal in a cave underwater. Unsure of why but after reading this you get the feeling that you want to break the seal.

b0MIGBNX9DGWiHQJ.description: Stranger in my dreams: This book talks about the author recalling a depraved creature who over time got closer and closer to her in her dreams. The book seems to be a diary and was never finished. When you read the last finished page in this book you take 1d8 points of psychic damage.

xQYL18jIrEAi5yib.description: Curiosity Kills the Cat: When you open this thick maroon colored book you quickly realize there is only one page inside. The text drips onto the floor as soon as you begin to read it. You cannot understand any of the text but you immediately realize the text tells of your demise.

CH9rY1K1MQlMsdBM.description: Influence of the Ocean: This book can only be read when near the ocean or on a rainy day. Inside the book talks about a man who is waiting for you in the ocean. He mentions all of the rewards he is keeping for you. If you roll and succeed an insight check DC16 you’ll find out that this is man is lying to you. If he is real or not you don’t know.

hzCW29KxhnnuB4ry.description: Diary of a Thief: This book is a pocket sized leather diary. Every time a player finishes a page of this book they lose a gold coin Unsure of where it went.

jaR1lTKrBod6kzVV.description: Uncle Chuv’s Peanut Butter Problem: Upon reading this the room will smell more and more like peanut butter. When the book is finished it will mold into a jar of endless peanut butter. It is impossible to get rid of this book normally. The only way to get rid of this book is to burn the jar in fire. If you attempt to eat a spoonful of this peanut butter you take 1d4 points of psychic damage.

sbZ7biYgfUNYbj7K.description: Changing Secrets: This sparkling book smells like incense. Inside the book talks about one of your secrets (ask player). This book when read causes every person in the room to know one secret of yours.

WhOLcIPvqRfy1h9a.description: Patterns of Behavior: an anthology of mood effecting quilt work – a small hardcover picture book of patterns that slightly effect one’s mood.

CcgvqrrGx3LMap2s.description: Timeless Words of Wisdom for the Courtroom, Phrases That Persuade From the Backwoods to the Big City: This is a full compendium of philosophical and legal summaries that can arm a budding lawyer with a mental skill set to be cunning and out think their opponent.

9rcUBl0DW6EFbOiK.description: Fifty Shades of Drow: A bestseller among women, as it details the finer points of the Matriarchal society. With tips on how to properly train and punish your man-servants while maintaining your femininity, this book would be banned if only men would actually read it.

MPRWL3c0PkVIKjUx.description: Where is that dragon egg? A handy tip book for managing clutter in the workshop.

GynvmmxZnGq1UVtC.description: Fireside Singalongs: A simple songbook for bored travelers, with optional sheet music for instrumental accompaniment.

QOtL2RxxWbn7PVrW.description: Income Management and Financial Assessment: A book containing several long chapters detailing ways to horde, hide, and invest gold. Hidden within are several nude illustrations of females of the common races.

D5urUVRpKXlWdmps.description: The life and times of Volo: Autobiographical book featuring the exaggerated and often blatantly false adventures of the well traveled Volo.

hv1utC1WushI2SkI.description: What To Do When You Find Children: A guidebook to dealing with found children and other such inconveniences in various dangerous situations.

awJftGF50t41vbul.description: Learn To Read: An incredibly dense book that details the process of learning the art of reading Common, almost impossible to understand, even for those fluent in Common.

ObCKN8OKaim4jCSD.description: Gobbo and Me: – A children’s book about the dangers of befriending Goblins.

8fTH2ThkOw1GUX2k.description: An Almanack of Practical Mortis: An exhaustive collection of tables detailing how corpses decompose under various circumstances, along with an appendix that explains step-by-step how to remove maggots, close large wounds, and reset broken bones. If the players obtain it second-hand, bits of paper with names such as “Aunty Milla” and “Betrand (4c3r)” are attached by weak adhesive to some of the pages. A successful Perception check reveals that there are slight remnants of adhesive left above each note, as if someone kept moving the note down the page over time.

AtjTgxGgrpWnE5w3.description: A Study on Cloud Castles: This book presents numerous theories on how the giant’s fabled cloud castles might work.

zIap1Al69TvguHxk.description: How to Talk to Gnolls Without Getting Torn to Shreds: This book is based off of the notes of an ambitious goblin who was evidently torn to shreds.

1PpYdS94K6tKflhc.description: The Beasts of Menita Valley: A book detailing the magical fauna of a valley you have never heard of.

hsgh8jF14eeh0BAc.description: All Horns & Tails? A Beginner’s Guide on Everything Tieflings: Halifar the Bard walks you through the wide and wild world of Tieflings, their heritage, and how to even make friends with our infernal neighbors.

YyLgQTfJCYrzr1Wn.description: 1001 Edible & Magical Plants of Chult: Visiting Chult but not sure what to eat and what to avoid? This information packed book is the definitive guide on navigating the delicious, dangerous gardens of Chult.

LSnGDzpQ3e8V2dlK.description: A Raven Flew Overhead: The Raven Queen, lady of mystery and intrigue. Misunderstood. Antihero? Quillo Quillorobor delves into the history of this storied individual, parsing fact from fiction. With exclusive interviews with folks who knew her best, all the way from the Shadowfell itself, this book is a must read.

4Zxf5ebGJUaSGqGO.description: Fun With Tears: A book detailing the magical and alchemical properties of tears.

DEsVpLUwDJMDwujB.description: The Social Practices of Various Avian Humanoids: This book tells you all you need to know about interacting with bird people.

pvNVek27VYB1PfV2.description: Fey’runds Tales: a children’s book of fables.

3RosApHvlW0iNHEA.description: Eye: A tale of the journey of the company of the eye. Their rise, their fall, their legacy.

WYWTN0yNW329F0nR.description: Naught but the Wind’s Caress: A collection of torrid love stories between a High Elf and their Human lover.

LO18Dvtco8aX312n.description: Illuminarium Battalia: A manual of fighting with magic and steel.

37peKebEVrJQwdKc.description: Where Is The Pancreas, and How To Prepare It: The cannibal’s guide to fine dining.

flDv8lj2kbUX0BgD.description: Rock Hard: The definitive guide to Dwarven diplomacy.

oXk7bOmCdXjKFHSh.description: Red Goes Faster: The definitive biography of Zomo the mad goblin who broke out of the celestial sphere and returned to tell about it.

zbZKtMzVs3HZVPaO.description: The Skull – A heavy book filled with a long stream-of-consciousness narrative describing a single humanoid skull in careful detail. The narrator seems completely focused on the skull, never describing its origins, its surroundings, or themselves.

PtNmbouv5WlwCf8M.description: Kobold Jokes: A joke book, written in Draconic. The jokes are terrible, even by Kobold standards.

IznZkADBsroYD91f.description: A Treatise On The Non-Existence Of This Treatise: A small pamphlet that attempts to convince the reader that the pamphlet does not exist, and that it is in fact a figment of the reader’s imagination. Despite being written in a very academic and generally formal tone, the arguments within are mostly circular or otherwise fallacious.

02dW6W9LdRDYThpH.description: Dream Journal: A carefully illustrated dream journal by a famous wizard of old, containing a large amount of arcane truths. The pages have been scrawled with black ink, rendering it illegible.

7rtur5a8wz0AMXSd.description: Necromancy for Imbeciles: An introductory guide to the basics of necromancy. Has been hollowed out to allow for storage, though it appears normal. Contains a skeleton of a large rodent.

VvAB6gD6O5lKXhAc.description: The Ravings of Garvus [3rd Edition]: The assorted notes and thoughts of an ancient and powerful wizard from an era long past. His mind was obliterated upon making contact with unknown entities, but records of his journey into madness remain.

ZAr2cGxB96Xeyc18.description: Hilarious Knock-Knock Jokes to Say Out Loud: A thin and suprisingly old-looking book containing a few genuinely good knock-knock jokes. At least one punchline is actually the true name of a powerful demon.

LviBBkZtZqP1n4pf.description: The Next Hunt – Volume I: Wyverns: The first in a series of installments detailing an abundance of methods for finding and hunting various monsters. Each volume covers a different creature.

J6Ug91Cyx9olNbK8.description: Let Me Out Of Here: Once a simple children’s picture book, it is now the seal for multiple malevolent poltergeists that break free of the book’s pages when it is opened. They are not particularly grateful to those who released them.

sFADyBT9EcFRm9Xm.description: “Help! I’m a dwarf turned into a book”

mkRertUZBRuhmo4z.description: Short But Stout: A list of recipes and information on Dwarven ale.

kLwQfOgONqBTNBXs.description: The Tale Of Crimshaw The Sweet: A legendary tale of an infamous Tiefling baker who killed dozens of orcs by baking them poisonous cookies.

nulCWHWPHHlfazXq.description: Orc Smith Compendium: An extensive informative book about Orcish weaponry, armor, and miscellaneous metal items.

1yiUDKICoZttvw7k.description: Animated Apocrypha: A Book of Movement and Morals: An enchanted book of tales with illustrations that move on their own in a set repeating pattern. The tales tend to connect to the nearest civilization and depict stories of good morals.

NG2KtDPdJQqstcke.description: 101 Morsels And Monsters: A cook book detailing various recipes based around safely using the meat of creatures adventurers might slay in battle.

NtZ6803bfvIvrGmd.description: Coppers For Your Thoughts: A small book of random musings, quotes, and anecdotes. None are attributed to any authors.

tdb2llxEu508V80k.description: An Anatomical Study of Magical Creatures: A set of 6 volumes on the interior structure of magical, extra-planar beings.

CKfih9v3tzAJ9RmH.description: On the History of the First Era: A historical documentation of the day-to-day life in the antiquated Prime Material.

JfL8SKcxfQE89XDP.description: Tome Prime: A thick book of hundreds of pages in a language unintelligible to all but the author; seems to be a novel of some sort.

Sp3g9fXf3kvdbJL0.description: Verdant Home: A slim book where the words are mangled by travel into the Far Realm. Seems to tell the story of a family in an impossible home.

UWADAxpZD0JWEJCN.description: A Herbalist’s Guide to Surviving: This diary details the accounts a famous halfling smuggler, who was best known for smuggling his home made rum into kingdoms throughout the world during the great alcohol depression. With proper study the reader can reproduce the famous Sweetfoot Rum recipe from the different mentions, hints and references scattered across the pages of this book.

RmOEWQCIb717zU0B.description: The Fall of the Empire: On the surface, this appears to merely be a recounting of the opulent Haloan Empire’s fall from power centuries ago. Some claim, however, that careful analysis reveals it as a scathing commentary on the notoriously corrupt court of King Judicus, written in code to keep the author from harm.

0lJTEyGkarp25Q1N.description: Arcane Secrets: A generous manuscript contains description of inner workings of various contraptions and automatons and instruction manual to programming automatons, allowing any intermediate transmuter to create their very own contraptions!

wiw6rlzdzwh2zwm5.description: From Ghouls to Ghosts: The book is chaotic and hard to understand, written in an unknown dialect which makes it very slow to read. Contained within are the studies of a powerful necromancer on how interplanar travel might be used to achieve functional immortality.

weqe2k5XrYEmxsjz.description: Our Friend the Cactus: Written by a dwarf wizard by the name of Daven Wraithmail, this treatise explains the growth and upkeep of a Gulthias Tree as well as several manners to corrupt seeds of other trees in order to create a suitable vessel. An entire chapter is dedicated to the domestication of the resulting blights which sprout from said tree and their training to better protect your new sapling.

sfhHJKpfDP1iiq95.description: To Cheat A Devil: The autobiography of a man who tricked dozens of minor devils, and even a few archdevils into doing his nefarious bidding. It seems like this man should be much more well known if the events described in this book actually took place.

BpusjY8dhKssdecj.description: There, they’re, their, and back again: A halfling’s guide to grammar.

0V4IbFFsYhm62SFk.description: Don’t You Worry About The Bugs!: Every thing you need to know about bugs. Rise, feed, kill and cook your best friend!

qVQhr4iHAQrRorhv.description: The True Rulers of Our Countries: A controversial document in and of its own right, this book talks about the creation of the Prime Material and Inner planes. A thin volume which only contains 4 pieces of paper, however these papers are magically enchanted to pass through the thousands of pages of content which this book holds. The author of the document seems almost too knowing on the subject, almost as if he were there…

dc8CiyXaTH8CwVkv.description: Stories from the Orkholds: A collection of poems written by an orcish adventurer and skald. The majority of the book is an epic saga, recounting the various deeds of the adventuring party the poet was a part of, with later short poems about specific aspects of adventurers’ lifestyle. The later poems touch on a wide array of topics, such as the joys of a shared victory, longing for hearth and home, and the simple pleasure of splitting a foe in half lengthwise.

3Vb4F58L1np4zDWH.description: The Night’s Embrace: A book about the primordial titans, mostly legend and myth, collected by an eccentric young wizard who traveled the planes looking for information about them. This book is highly frustrating to scholars because the last entry is the beginning of a summary of an actual historical document, which has never been found. The book is unfinished and the wizard has not been seen for hundreds of years.

KNePre8nsYkIBkQk.description: The Story of Graye: The story of a slave forced to be a pit-fighter who turned to meditation as an escape from his violent life. This book is not well written, and is probably an earlier work of a novice author that never reached wide spread fame.

817eAzpcNlLy3dbr.description: The Inner Workings of a Gulthias Tree: A dense acedemic treaty on the biology of cacti. If one has the patience it is very interesting in its own way. The book also details a large number of edible cacti, as well as those that can be used as water sources in the harsh deserts.

AnDGc5qPsy49F1u4.description: 1011 Prayers for the Dead: A large, black covered book describing the funerary rituals of almost every culture in the known world.

bFNhN5AHLgNRkoWE.description: On “The Aleum”: This book is a modern copy very ancient commentary on an epic poem named The Aleum, which was already very ancient when On “The Aleum” was written. No original copy of The Aleum has been located, therefore On “The Aleum” has fascinated historians.

AWE7ZineFdSiKjgj.description: Raising the Steaks: A comprehensive guide on rearing cattle in environments that are likely to include monsters. Includes detailed and somewhat bizarre methods to scare away potential predators.

jNGaja4TbUsdOzf1.description: FINISH THEM: A bright red book that talks about the coolest ways to end a brutal fight. (PC who reads this can roll intimidation once after reading it for killing someone)

sKliweSn3KDBpifL.description: Do it Yourself – Comic Book: A yellow book that’s empty at first. Over the course of a month though the book will fill itself with all the adventures you go on. The cooler the adventures and dialogue the more the book is the worth if you sell it!

gvvpNwu5Ilw5KGW7.description: A Story About The Letter X: This pretty orange book was written by Marc Dahspaht. Honestly not sure who that could be the book talks about the best ways of hiding gold and making a map to lead to it.

MYht5s0xlb6ITA96.description: The Aarcana-sutra: A one stop guide to magic and its uses within the bedroom.

FFG9ylZ25LGc9lhf.description: Cooking with pig meat: A book that smells like bacon. You try to read it, but the pages inside the cover are wrapped in bacon. If you try to unwrap it, it’s bacon all the way down, until you get to a small slip of paper that says “oink”.

pEIuxJlaeX8iME06.description: Golden Fleece: Empty book, has 50 gold coins in it. Has a page describing gold and how tasty it is. Upon further inspection, the gold coins are chocolate.

ReQJtiRSKK8C4z8N.description: Library Book of Libraries: A photo book showing a series of decrepit bookshelves, along with locations.

Items in an NPC’s Pockets.name: Items in an NPC’s Pockets
Items in an NPC’s Pockets.description: One hundred items you might find while digging in an NPC's pockets!Credit: http://dndspeak.com

XZVpXt19tB8mbTci.description: A diary/journal that goes in detail about the NPC’s life. Further inspection reveals that there is one or two minor magic scrolls between some of the pages.

nTyK0KBpK8WOLVvP.description: A bag of various gems and jewelry equal to about 300 gold.

KWItaA3kIQlsjgdf.description: A key, with no information of what it is used for. Turns out to be a key stolen from a guard that opens the keep.

VoO4WkRUHCIE1381.description: A golden ring worth 100gp and a note ‘today’s the day!’.

f8PuBtJ1QI28KHOk.description: A fishing hook, roll a DC 20 dex save to not have your fingers on it and yell out in pain with your hand still in the pocket.

c8uRpIep4XBfskeI.description: A love poem, yet to be delivered.

lz2TnZyhYGq0B0ev.description: The transcript of an ancient prophecy, describing a heroic person looking a lot like one of the players.

hD3W8mwExldZM5Wk.description: A brass signet ring given to members of a guild or cult. There is an engraving on the inside that says ‘Don’t be a jerk,’ in dwarvish.

X4QVYZxzhVUhKtp9.description: Nothing. The pockets open to bare skin.

BiOmGnkPlcVnMXF4.description: Warrant for Arrest: The warrant depicts an illustration of they who fell the villager, with a DEAD OR ALIVE bounty of 500gp.

tWjo686ChpcUB1iT.description: ‎Keyring of Tools: This savvy farmer had a wizard shrink each of his farming tools (shovel, hoe, scythe, axe, plough, pitchfork, and rake) to the size of keys for easy transportation. Whenever he needed them, he simply popped them off the magical ring.

k7z70guJ9NgZZG2N.description: ‎Coin Pouch Empath: A peculiar thing of leather and string, the coin pouch empath is sad and forlorned when empty, but overjoyed and greedy when full. These emotions pour into who so ever carries it.

5NYafGMVxxko959q.description: ‎Take Me Back to Sea Shell: Seemingly innocent pocket fodder of the nostalgic seaman, this shell carries within it the sound of the nearest sea, including lively docks, bustling markets, all of sea-kind, and intelligent voices. More time spent listening delivers greater insight into actual discussions, known creature calls, and suggestions of tide and weather– but beware, some Take Me Back shells are known to maintain a fiesty crab!

Wefqdc4cY1OYn2zr.description: ‎Anti-Theft Stitching: Those quick to trifle will find their wrists stitched in this anti-theft pocket lining! The leather sack wraps tightly around the wrist with magical strength, rendering the hand useless like that in a bag. The pocket bag can only be opened by command of the pocket’s owner or the tailor who set the trap. The leather is not so sure to be easily removed– the trap tightens at the wrist with any attempt.

aeuOih1a2LpsDUpM.description: A small peice of parchment with the words ‘Dear (npc’s name) I have always loved you. If you love me back, please meet me at the tavern tonight. If you are not there, I will understand’.

WH9LgmOcmNDDCfvF.description: A small bone knife carved with runes and pulsing faintly with magic, this hobgoblin good luck charm allows one to reroll an attack roll or any skill check involving a melee or ranged weapon once per day.

CUSO89jGhI0aR8OI.description: A palm-sized brass coin from a distant Fire Giant city. This Giant coin is equal to 1d4+1 Gold Pieces if you can find a money changer who will accept it.

P35vP3fSsXt47MCZ.description: A paper napkin with a few stanzas of poetry or a partial diagram of a machine scrawled on it. 24

mbqdVEJUfgHPZN0y.description: A piece of chalk and a ripped parchment with Infernal runes and part of a magic circle drawn on it.

geEZC6MbW18gbIxp.description: A bag full of coins, each one from a different country.

VLuFIIxkyaaqhnWh.description: A deck of unique cards and a booklet with instructions to play a game of war with them.

8JBMltZfn9RsoY4a.description: A leather bag full of seeds.

dtZzS0x37RcNcFJY.description: A paper with the last thing a PC did or said to the NPC written on it.

Uvdma2QErx78t4gM.description: A strange cube with buttons on it and cogs.

fYJ4AJ18kcEFLcUV.description: A roughly scribbled map on a piece of parchment, folded up three times.

qqQdrvoaEgVl5pNy.description: Shimmering dust in a vial which after some investigation appears to be the remains of a will o wisp.

NiHCAQs515p2sJNf.description: An old love letter, neatly but repeated folded and worn from age.

7vRbgNlGCYpevjks.description: A small, simple pen knife. The handle is old and the wood is worn so that the maker’s mark is no longer visible. 36

a7IUEAtRyxQhR2qb.description: A poorly made rope doll with button eyes and frayed yellow cloth for hair.

aJ9g05aoOfLoRI5W.description: A tiny nugget of fool’s gold, worthless.

7TmZoeKpyxCIK7BZ.description: An empty tinder box, the insides are scortched black.

w6VBGxakH6FzuYCz.description: A folded piece of parchment warning citizens of pick pockets.

PnHtVeoMLztpmOx1.description: A coin purse with a message in thieves cant. The message warns the thief to return the purse or else.

D4Qu8vuMmLsLQSdo.description: An invitation to join the local thieves guild.

5XOuTA8dnKo1mhHr.description: A bottle cork with a small blue star inked on the bottom.

SeMgwGlhgDgfkInK.description: A gold coin hidden in a loaf of bread.

pAkA9d2CKf81onp4.description: Some crumpled handwritten receipts for goods and small change.

GKQbEanpo3fYa4qa.description: A spare pair of clean, but clearly old underwear. Turns out the pocket owner has incontinence and brings backups for accidents.

Sx50uPQBvQmHxHU4.description: A magical anti-pickpocket snaptrap. It snaps on the thief’s fingers loudly and painfully with needle-like teeth and turns the thief’s hand bright purple as though indelibly dyed.

ZJ1wCfLLgQliTzqG.description: A half-eaten bread snack wrapped in leaves.

nAvgmdZtwPqYE5Qk.description: A lovenote (from whomever the DM decides.)

DQ6bQxx1fRNDOsos.description: A ‘Pocket’ dimension the size of a pocket.

1agsA29D5ssxBuQ2.description: A key to a secret lockbox kept under the NPC’s bed.

czMPIWD8JPv9vWvd.description: A small knife in a deerskin wrap. The handle has another NPC’s name carved on it, surrounded by little hearts.

bsJijVLsWDg9OOcH.description: A sealed scroll. Depicts an expertly drawn image of a rude gesture, captioned by the words ‘Fuck you, buddy.’ The text is magical and can be read in any language, so the scroll detects as magic before you open it.

EmTjgwh59oIZGOWX.description: A big turkey leg, like the size of a large man’s hand.

A5tyfyVwrK7fbu3W.description: A closed thimble filled with cabbage soup.

tQUO5nxKmpfpm4LF.description: A small, malleable ball of fluorescent green… something. Aside from molding it with your hands, you can exert your will onto it to make finer shapes.

Yt7kP5V7DXFlv5zN.description: A small pouch of nuts and dried meats.

yegXUNVFRxlWZKcW.description: A vial containing something resembling soot. If identified, it is revealed to be a vial of ashes.

hBxwilTvpXsIYdzF.description: A small hoard of sheets of paper, all seemingly collected from the corners of posted notices; none are larger than a square inch.

fMNSu97jbZewYSty.description: Just a few clods of dirt and some pebbles.

CZpKmouMjmuQhMIe.description: A single metal needle bent into a perfect circle.

UEupShOSlNIofbDl.description: A wax seal of a prominent noble in the land who has recently gone missing.

KDhPJvQh4YWaWry2.description: A scrap of paper with a script that you can’t read (PC doesn’t know it is written in illusory script).

N7CV92c0IXeT63LG.description: A charm of obsidian antlers on a broken chain.

Rr7kwrY6l9mw5vOz.description: A couple of pieces of chalk.

1ctJ9uwIeM3By59K.description: A crumpled note that is damaged beyond legibility.

8e4fADmKaXJqRa61.description: A scrap of parchment that has a map drawn on it. It seems to be of streets in a city, but you can’t tell where.

cdj2kVkBoPOUt3dv.description: A bag of boogers they’ve been saving for some sick reason.

FlOhHIjdsqDjHqZ5.description: A love letter to the PC’s mother.A scroll that reads, ‘I have prepared explosive runes.’A scroll that reads, ‘If you’re reading this, I’m right behind you.’

upcQ4PuMMAyDlVGY.description: A popular novel published recently with an elven-made bookmark stuck inside.

99kHKB3zOWXHNc8l.description: A very small spellbook containing 3 cantrips and 2 first-level spells. There are also notes about the location of dungeons and the layout of magical ley lines in the area.

GbAdo69IX1Q3Z0fQ.description: A cracked or flawed ioun stone in a felt-lined box.

B0IUxQS5ZcahJnm7.description: An enchanted 10 foot pole that somehow fits in any ordinary pocket.

VI16XZvxjOm5rbwF.description: A half eaten piece of jerky.

h4ReGEmhcXcQ7cJi.description: A folded note that reads ‘come to (x place) at dusk, thursday night, or you’ll never see her again. come alone, and bring the money. Or else.’

69Ob2Tr8PdnlIAwh.description: A canine tooth with a tiny metal dogtag next to it. It only has a very tiny paw print carved onto it.

CBQGD2ItcLgFJhLe.description: An envelope with money and a small letter apologizing for the small amount, promising not to spend any on food next time so the kids will have more.

k0p74COxbtkH1MG8.description: An old, tarnished wedding ring obviously not worn in a while.

ZhHHzHgm552FQEk8.description: A collector’s set of very tiny letter openers.

UdrAPqg86ZY0gZCg.description: Very large clumps of tangled hair tied tightly together, holding a robin’s egg inside.

X8wDQnxpU81VEimW.description: A certificate of adoption for a boy at a local orphanage.

aEQVulWFHR3sW6kB.description: A letter to a loved one promising them they will see them soon after nearly a decade apart.

23yYox8Cgdd1Czv9.description: Just a regular silver coin. There is nothing special about it. Nothing, really.

dW8gvno6WOW03H13.description: A wooden box filled with polished copper coins.

jmNr0rwvJutuuYEn.description: An advertisement for the local tavern.

Z8K1JxrFQ3jP1LPJ.description: A small loaf of bread filled with a spicy pepper sauce.

kQrLembSqyrAzArO.description: A small wooden figurine carved into the shape of an owlbear.

b6fz66OXKrBFZUkU.description: A well made doll. Odd… it looks like one of the players.

Library Books.name: Library Books
Library Books.description: One hundred books for your players to read.Credit: http://dndspeak.com

rFR30IyoTCFX6744.description: ‘101 Ways to Cook an Ooze’ – Interesting recipes include gelatinous cube cocktail, ochre apple jelly, and salted pudding

Z5NiY3QlILEAXkj5.description: ‘Physiologies of Magical Creatures’ – Information on the biology of Beholders, Dragons, Unicorns, and more. Full of diagrams.

ekWxJEzMaIlmEhY7.description: ‘The Prophecies’ – Tales of great adventures. Partway through, all the pages become blank

3utCwMvJbf1re7TG.description: ‘How to Spot a Mimic’ – Tips such as listen for breathing, and see if it responds to being touched

xdiK9E79Z5NuRhkc.description: ‘Bordrick’s Fantastic Adventure’ – Dwarven choose your own adventure book

nltTG0HCgj4N4YjE.description: ‘Planeshifting’ – Details different ways to travel between different planes of existence

FD7q7cHukTDUpTVq.description: ‘On Monstrous Races’ – Discusses whether monstrous races should or should not be allowed into society

raFSVhvj2M4heHTZ.description: ‘The Outside’ – A self-written account by someone you know who saw a vision of them self as a small plastic figurine on a table surrounded by a number of god-like beings after they talked to a group of adventurers

FDh9clEzqxbkeMeS.description: ‘Human?’ – Story about an ogre who, despite his incompetence, convinced everyone that he was actually a very tall human, became a king, then was discovered and beheaded.

IefoTCP2XJACzxgS.description: ‘Landmarks to Visit Before You Die’ – Details a number of landmarks and monuments in a country or city you have never heard of

WDB8KjnR751ki8Py.description: ‘The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Kingdom’ – A book with not entirely inaccurate advice on ‘how to see the kingdom on less than 30 copper pieces a day’. The very first page contains only the words ‘Don’t Panic’ printed in large, friendly letters.

fhzSaqtLj79uWoft.description: ‘Incredible Creatures and How to Kill Them’ – Details weaknesses monsters are known to have. It is part of a five-volume set; the first volume is for beginners (level 1-4), the second for the somewhat experienced (level 5-8) and so on.

9nckKphapYybULwK.description: ‘Magic for Dummies’ – Explains what magic is and how it works in the style of ‘___ for Dummies’ books. Does not teach one how to cast spells.

6mhr2sLS6xLWlc9w.description: ‘Wish It, Want It, Screw It’ – detailed accounts of times the Wish spell backfired horribly.

jCgHv0KaXmWaQEOq.description: ‘So Long, and Thanks for All the Ale’ – The story of Tarvish the dwarf, who had unpaid bar tabs worth a total of 10,000 gold all across the country before being arrested

8bI36cK4msfVnNsf.description: ‘Flumphs; the Pleasant Surprises of the Underdark’ – A journal accounting some time that a researcher spent living with a cloister of flumphs. The author documented at least once every day for a month

8d2HsVk3oTmYKkcr.description: ‘Taming the Beast’ – A perfect book for beginner beastmasters. Gives tips and tricks on how to win over wild creatures of all kinds. It starts with tiny creatures like frogs and crabs, followed by small creatures like eagles and fire beetles, medium creatures like giant badgers and giant frogs, large creatures like owlbears and bulettes, and finishes with huge creatures like elephants and some dinosaurs.

HIzV48wPglhQx9WJ.description: ‘A Day in the Life of a Lemure’ – A beginner demon/devil researcher decided to start his studies on the weakest of all fiend kind, the lemure. After summoning a lemure in a remote location, he watched its behavior for a day. After gathering the information needed, the author had the hideous abomination placed within a special containment vessel, alongside the many empty ones that would house the many other fiends. At the end of the book lies a map to the research facility. If the party decides to go there, they will find out that the author finished doing research on an imp, manes, and dretch as well.

E0RwvBkynQmGQNBF.description: ‘The Spider King’ – A fictional tale of an adventurer delving into the underdark to slay a fearsome giant spider.

gWTeRxnpjfR7HV53.description: ‘The Bjernson Family Tree And Exploits’ – The family tree of a nordic clan with all the males named Bjern Bjernson. This book helps tell them apart.

zObIbSwx6U0CAnpR.description: ‘Rosaline And Mercutio’ – A romantic tragedy by Bill Shaking-lance.

eTvlwCQfWH53dGGx.description: ‘Pictures of Cats’ – A picture book full of photos of cats dressed in cute outfits and doing cute things. It’s about the size of an average dictionary.

VS1PWlIU2fhuMT00.description: ‘I Can’t Believe It’s Not Harmless!’ – A hefty guide of herbs, mushrooms and berries that surround the city where the book was found. It contains accurate annotations of the ailments due to consumption or touch, with descriptive drawings of people having diarrhea or throwing up.

kQ7hWXDCpItrlIlJ.description: ‘Hit The Apple, Not My Face!’ – A Detailed Guide to Archery’ This book even includes instructions for constructing a simple bow and targets.

7GsR9wHIns7vEXGr.description: ‘Baby Dragon Destroys the Village’ – A truly heartwarming children’s book.

xXWfyjLFDNtQYv2k.description: ‘AAARRGGHH!: A Barbarian’s Guide to Clobbering Your Enemies’ – The writing is messy and misspelled, and some of the letters are are backwards. What’s more, the cover is splattered with blood on the bottom right corner, like someone was violently clobbered by the book.

2hvVUEB81F6RiYze.description: ‘The Three Little Goblins’ – Three goblins set off to build houses of wood, straw, and enchanted brick and start new lives, but the Big Bad Dire Wolf complicates things.

adaZPX3hdi73187k.description: ‘Claiming the Crown’ – An Experienced Guide to Assassinating Royals’ – How to brew a poison, how to create a disguise, tips on wielding daggers, and more!

62O9EQi4Bpoucffl.description: ‘The Banshees I Have Loved’ – A tragedy of five acts.

UovLK97MYiyaGobR.description: ‘Phylomagenetics and the Herbalist’ – A primer for the professional and newcomer alike.

9gWYIUCDO5pBVqcJ.description: ‘Population Dynamics of Cryptosaurs’ – A treatise on the ever-evolving age structures of dragons by region and plane.

nmE9iFnTXIcFxUaM.description: ‘Memoirs of a Goblin’ – A dramatic, often erotic, first-person biography of a female goblin groomed to be a concubine in an exotic land. The author is a male elf.

IC6Tuw1jvTGfL4IM.description: ‘How to Win Friends and Enchant People’ – Despite the title, has nothing to do with magic, but it does have some good advice about how to make yourself seem more approachable.

qcd3ZZ04boaf2Gqk.description: ‘The Dragon with a Girl Tattoo’ – A psychological mystery thriller about a detective who befriends a shapeshifted silver dragon with a dark past, to find a murderer before he strikes again.

Mgk3LYnCZUmukdi4.description: ‘To Kill a Manticore’ – There isn’t a single manticore in the entire book, it’s about a half-orc on trial for a crime he didn’t commit and the halfling lawyer who represents him.

rE1L3zlVyKokIAtk.description: ‘The 7 Habits of Highly Effective Adventurers’ – A self-help book with an optimistic view of the steps a person must take to succeed as an independent contractor with a sword.

I7hjOW8CFTMq28Xn.description: ‘Eat, Summon, Love’ – A married woman realizes how unhappy her marriage really is, and that her life needs to go in a different direction. After a painful divorce, she joins a cult of necromancers to ‘find herself’. Based on a true story.

XtA0WRhsbwNCpH8m.description: ‘Bahamut Shrugged’ – An action-thriller written by one of the world’s most controversial philosophers, the novel is set in a dystopia where magic is tightly regulated and only Gon Jalt can liberate magic-users from the non-magical ‘parasites’, i.e. everyone else.

QIRqjtUrHf4K0IqU.description: ‘Cockatrice Soup for the Soul ‘ – This book is so commonplace, it’s a cliche that in every house where a woman of a certain age lives, there will be at least one heavily-read copy of this book with it’s sappy stories and cloyingly sweet words of wisdom. It is beyond worthless.

Tsl6Nxs6G8ugAo4T.description: ‘The Origin of Magical Species’ – Full title: On the Origin of Magical Species by Means of Supernatural Selection, or the Preservation of Favoured Races in the Struggle for Life, is considered to be the foundation of understanding of how magic has shaped the evolution of the natural world. Although the theories presented inside are accepted as fact by nearly all universities and centers of learning, some religions regard it as heretical and have asked to have it banned.

KaGe791hTzEa8Gcc.description: ‘The Geographica Gelatinousa’ – 101 Oozes and How to Avoid Them

jt7F8aaRiG5qzVxV.description: ‘My Life as a Human Being’ – A Dragon’s Observation on Humanoid Culture

lju96K8OfOA6Sf1m.description: ‘Harold Haversham’s Holisitic Handbook of Healing’ – At first it appears to be a beginners guide to crafting potions, however as the book progresses the author becomes more and more adamant that all ailments are purely mental. There is a detailed account in which the author was treating a man for a broken arm and healed it through weekly mental therapy sessions.

pFhIPVz84w5Myzxf.description: ‘Wager like a Winner’ – A Goblins Guide to Gambling by Grey ‘Greedy’ Gradnok

cWE2BAvWBKII1ZMo.description: ‘The Wizard of Odds’ – Betting for Profit by B.M. Sawbuck

MRmQFEjETg8DbDMd.description: ‘So You Want to be a …..series’ – Illustrated beginner guides to becoming a Wizard, Druid, Ranger etc for children.

4bTZoQx5XTiOx2Dg.description: ‘The Potion Diaries’ – One Girl’s Intoxicating Adventures by Madame S. Ruth

x71ugrb1JA5C8aGu.description: ‘Lost in Translation’ – The Art of the Scribe by Thoth Gardiner

fPm6ktzfWsMw5ZLl.description: ‘Fitting a Square Peg Through a Round Hole: The curious mobility of oozes’

XDfUZ5CVogKp3k2Q.description: ‘Half Human, Half Horse, All Man’ – A defense of carnal relationships with beast races

cRag3c3aH27MlZmZ.description: ‘Halfling Histories’ – An incomplete telling of the tales of the half-folk

uU6BTT1DpAs0QWbR.description: ‘The Orc’s Cookbook: 101 ways to prepare an elf’ – To make the hunt taste delicious

D0UWGoAeXq4C7G9r.description: ‘Every. Accomplished. Recognizable. Sentient. by Tommeltop the Gnome’ – An encyclopedia of anyone who accomplished anything of moderate note ever, however most of each page is dedicated to greatly exaggerated, suitably cringy and oddly romantic paragraphs about how great each person’s ears must have been. Any brave soul who actually reads the book through is suddenly able to recall in perfect detail the ears of anyone they’ve ever seen before,for no apparent reason. (Perhaps there are drawings and details of the pc’s and their ears as well)

MMPXiLWI6oR9YQhR.description: ‘The Lord of the Rings’ A historical fiction-esque set of books about an adventuring party ages ago in a material plane far, far away.

tx3RlJasIIX3XyJQ.description: ‘Names to Run Away From’ – A collection of monsters, plant, fungus, magical phenomenon and other miscellaneous ‘things’ that even the most accomplished – or desperate- of adventurers avoid – for they are easy to kill, but they are also a mighty pain in the behind and, even more importantly, in your wallet.

koVRZSUiU6M2wzdc.description: ‘The Legend of Atlas’ – A collection of the all the known myths and legends in the world from the beginning of the written to the present.

JngxpTLIdr1sZnzL.description: ‘Merfolk Companions’ – This book details how Merfolk capture and train seals as pets.

bT34ZeqGnN1wtzvx.description: ‘Forever and Always’ – The future predictions of a historian who lived two centuries ago. His predictions continue on for another four hundred years.

3xcbTTNDeQiEN3vr.description: ‘Prince of Reality’ – A philosophical book that tries to explain the true nature of reality.

wbAC2CVD6xvk8M3y.description: ‘The Common Woman’s Guide to Royalty’ – A guide on how every lady should act in society.

UvaL5uaLWfTLdmYe.description: ‘The Witch’s Guide to Home brew Potions’ – A series of tips on how to be the most successful witch you can be

fiDoW1Ga9FhVyIva.description: ‘Becoming a Paladin: A full guide to becoming the lawful good person you always hoped to be!’ – This thick volume even includes how to protect orphanages and the correct means of smiting your enemies.

eI9zmYAdIQaiG5w7.description: ‘Being Familiar With Your Familiar: The book for casters who wish to bond with their animal companions’ – A field guide to all common and some uncommonly seen familiars in the area.

7SGVQJkiR0yjTpna.description: ‘New Technology: Summer Special Edition’ – This information source gives details on many new forms of technology, such as reinforced crossbows, iron hunting traps, and many, many magic items.

xBmeRXhifmOik70d.description: ‘The Tao of Earth’ – Starts with philosophical musings about the importance of creation and stability over destruction and change. This book is written in an old dialect that most people (even magic users) have trouble reading. It occasionally goes on long-winded philosophical tangents.

m1HGIkMUkct3d2bP.description: ‘The Tao of Water’ – Starts with a note: lava and water is basically the same thing! don’t try to use fire spells on it. If you fail to understand this basic, the Tao will forever escape you. This book is written in an old dialect that most people (even magic users) have trouble reading. It occasionally goes on long-winded philosophical tangents.

4bLqzKYwJLyFQBh8.description: ‘The Tao of Air’ – Starts with philosophical musings on how a fickle thing like air is needed for (long-lived) living creatures to breathe. There is a 5% chance of an ancient erotic letter being found loose inside. This book is written in an old dialect that most people (even magic users) have trouble reading. It occasionally goes on long-winded philosophical tangents.

jbQWiiNJS2ppejgx.description: ‘The Tao of Fire’ – Starts with a strict warning to master at least one of the other 3 elemental books first, because while many people think playing with fire is fun, it’s not worth dying over. This book is written in an old dialect that most people (even magic users) have trouble reading. It occasionally goes on long-winded philosophical tangents.

Ig5J994MZyUASnT7.description: ‘The Tao of Life’ – This volume is the thickest, but somehow the least complete; it contains many anatomical diagrams, as well as several normative references to The Tao of Death. This book is written in an old dialect that most people (even magic users) have trouble reading. It occasionally goes on long-winded philosophical tangents.

DFJ6T83AhFoyY0ik.description: ‘The Tao of Death’ – This volume is missing from most sets after a book-burning campaign, but its existence is well known. This book is written in an old dialect that most people (even magic users) have trouble reading. It occasionally goes on long-winded philosophical tangents.

l8GR3tgkgjnnZXOE.description: ‘The Tao of Secrets’ – The existence of this volume is not widely known, and its veracity is debated among scholars; all claimed copies of this volume appear to consist entirely of blank pages, which nobody has ever manage to cast a spell to extract the information out of – thus suspicions that they’re fake. But they do appear to be just as old as the other volumes …

AkMYqtbPh2Kj0Ok7.description: ‘Fifty Shades of Drow’ – Part history and part fan fiction starring Lolth.

aJabj3fSLW8zParH.description: ‘The Summoning of Dragons’ – A Celestial’s guide to the methods and dangers of calling on the great reptiles.

NBXEE8nJRiL4XtA5.description: untitled book – this book contains no text, and has a small hole cut into the pages which contains something of value (coins, a key, etc.)

sDQJAiGffhsxlEt1.description: ‘Keeper of the Keys’ – Whenever a creature reads this book, they slowly fall asleep then ‘awaken’ inside the book (their body remains in the real world). Living inside of the book is a half-man, half-dog extraplanar being who owns a copy of every key in existence, and whose only entertainment is reading books, but several of the books available for him to read are unfinished close to their ending. The party can enter the incomplete books to finish their stories (incomplete books could be a story of a great battle, a story where an assassin must be chased down, or something similar), and should they finish all of the stories given to them to complete, the Keeper of the Keys shall give them a key. Should they die inside of a book, a person will simply be ejected from it, rather than die outright.

yOEM65E5LeU2zVND.description: ‘Gnome means Gnome’ – A beginner’s guide to understanding the differences between the shorter races of the realm.

pG5nlt5T1vbwRKoE.description: ‘Sparing?’ – An orc bandit slowly goes from blood raging pillager to being a member of society. A heartwarming tale of death, destruction, and love.

OIJFkmfTR3NJhFsp.description: ‘Deck of Limiting Things’ – A collection of possibly true tales about people who used the deck of many things and the chaos that followed.

Tym49WV8SZMN5GXi.description: ‘The Art of Procrastination and How to Perfect it’ – A book filled with scribbles. It is only halfway finished

UomTdL0A8ckc7o5D.description: ‘Forging for Dummies’ – A book on how to forge weapons and tools, writen by a dwarf as a gift to his human pupil.

eb3SzDs76Td6mbKL.description: ‘Diamonds in the rough’- A book on soul gems and their proper creation.

QhAlDuknyQDqxniy.description: ‘The very hungry Chimera’- A children’s book detailing the complicated diet of a magical monster. It ends with the chimaera eating an adventuring party and falling asleep.

mcXiXESX0ziFQGFr.description: ‘Guinness’ Book of world records’- A book crafted over a lifetime by an adventurer named Guinness. It contains accomplishments such as ‘Worlds largest dragon’ ‘Longest time spent in a beholders lair’, ‘Fattest goblinoid’ And ‘Most monstrosities slain in a day

qLuqRb2t6UerQ1jm.description: ‘How to capture your princess’ – A collection of dating tips, advices and tricks, written by, for, and to men. Use it at your own risk!

v5Dm5tQvqwZ5ouBJ.description: ‘Backstage’ – Detailing the more mundane dangers of the adventuring life, like insufficient supplies, inappropriate gear, public reactions, illnesses and the common lack of money – with tips and advices how to prevent them (the second edition have humorous footnotes from the author).

xpg7S6vXRhAZv7y4.description: ‘You and Evil’ – A promotional(?) book from the Nine Hells. Details most of the pros and cons to working for the infernal realm, with useful notes on the ‘gray zones’. May cause surveillance by the temples of good.

5rAmbcvX4HWlfxOX.description: ‘Personal Care for Adventurers’ – Tells adventurers how to maintain a clean, healthy look after weeks in the wilderness.

xCVz9w7uRZTCSgBP.description: ‘Berries and You’ – Informs the reader on edible and inedible berries found in the wild.

OtO2rYhzwYI9v6l2.description: ‘Castle Architecture’ – A book about how castles and the like are constructed.

3fKQZVhtxmu7pGKe.description: ‘Bardic Legends From Far Away Lands’ – A book about legends often sung or performed by bards.

bieDgG2PEbxGzoSq.description: ‘How To Waste Good Paper’ – The pages inside this book are beautifully designed with colorful trim and a flowery layout. Other than the title, however, this book has no content in its pages. (Detect Magic: It is a spellbook written with magical invisible ink (or runes, etchings, message, mark, whatever) detailing only one spell to learn: Detect Magic)

hUtL7D9tvv7NQbrN.description: ‘Everyday Lives’ – A compilation of the contents of journals which were obtained from ordinary people.

mTl43t5bLYJIGR3r.description: Avatar: The Last Airbender’ – A 3 volume set of books in which a young elemental monk learns to harness his his power so that he may bring peace to a hundreds years war.

hOQb01mU9IuEn4gr.description: ‘Tic-Tic-Twang’ – A detailed guide for creating clockworks, golems, animated items, and traps, rather easily. Restricted in most kingdoms, as its too valuble to outright ban and destroy its knowledge, despite the widespread collaterral damage after its first releases. The bounty for the authors is still valid.

EWA4iUgEb2bXQyjZ.description: ‘Magic in the House’ – The legacy of an archmage suffering from an obsession about cleanliness. Explains how to use the different schools of magic to help with the chores around your home. Apprentices around the world curse whoever thought its good for thier training that they need to do those chores manually.

DRQWc4CRddU1jmzw.description: ‘Gary’s Guide to Gathering Gold’ – A story about how some guy named Gary wrote a role-playing game called ‘Fiends and Fortresses’ and made millions of gold selling thousands of copies.

QKA66fgazhvtq4e5.description: ‘Fiends and Fortresses – Player’s Handbook’ – A book on how the play the popular role-playing game ‘Fiends and Fortresses’, where players roll dice to fight fantastical creatures and adventure through fortresses while someone designated a ‘Fortress Master’ tells a story.

qjvVqqEWIo1zqVFr.description: ‘Fiends and Fortresses – Fortress Master’s Guide’ – A book on how to lead players through a story and gameplay in the popular role-playing game ‘Fiends and Fortresses’

rP63rE5da6kzZdKj.description: I wish my mother would pass already.

rdk3kBSNljzwMY1A.description: Who are these stupid awful people talking to me right now?

ZG3WgCs2HASMH8Ko.description: A slightly hunched skeleton rests peacefully within the coffin, several extremely desiccated bunches of flowers lie around it. The remains of some folded, mostly ruined pieces of paper lay where the occupant’s torso used to be. If you are able to make out any of the writing, the notes reveal that this was the much-loved, elderly mother of a large family. They wrote these notes and placed them in their mother/grandmother’s coffin. You feel incredibly guilty about disturbing this poor woman’s resting place.

Gd9weWMQm8MetSX5.description: A deathly pale, young humanoid that appears to be around twenty to thirty years of age. They are reclined comfortably in a deep, cushioned casket, reading a book. By the light of a magical smokeless candle they are very proud of, they beckon you down a hatch in the bottom of their casket to a small hidden cave. The cave, though dimly lit, is actually very homey. The walls are lined with over full, wooden bookcases, stacks of books line a narrow path to a comfortable chair. The youth explains that hundreds of years ago, they grew tired of being accused of vampirism just because they are immortal (they are very dismissive of the fact that they are immortal and don’t seem to know the source of their immortality themselves). They decided to gather as many books as they could, use the money they had put aside to construct this secret room and buy a comfortable coffin, then fake their death. Hundreds of years later they definitely don’t regret their decision, only pausing briefly before offering the party a quest for more books to fully restock the youth’s “library”, along with whatever reward is offered, the party gets all of the old books to do with as they please, as well as a small volume of surprisingly well written fanfiction.

2y3P6uOXKZCfK7p3.description: A completely empty coffin; though if you look hard enough, you find a trapdoor in the bottom. Opening the trapdoor, you find nothing but packed dirt.

2PsmwhyFp7HSWUzy.description: A skeleton of average height but prodigious girth. Resting side the abdomen and ribcage of the skeleton are several dozen smaller skeletons, most humanoid.

ZRgbNzsmFAowqEej.description: A skeleton that has had every single one of its bones broken neatly in half. Each tooth has been split down the middle, the skull has only a single crack splitting it diagonally, even the tiniest bones of the hands and feet have been cracked in two. Only the jawbone is whole.

IS93NZjYJUbsb26Q.description: A skeleton wearing exactly the same clothing and equipment as you. Any magical items are mundane and any weapons badly damaged and blunted. The skeleton is damaged in a way consistent with having been killed in the last significant combat encounter the player participated in, or was nearly killed in.

OVBH8aSuXxV4BgCh.description: Approaching the grave you see the ground has heaved up some not just above the grave, but for five feet on all sides as well. During your efforts to excavate the coffin, you find splintered wood, investigation of the wood reveals it to be from a coffin. Digging further down towards the rest of the coffin, you find a huge, hunched, mishapen skeleton. It appears, though twisted, to be posed as if it had been the one lain to rest in the coffin. Other uncovered parts of the coffin appear to be normal humanoid sized; coinpurse, tatters of clothing, even what remains of a pair of shoes near the huge skeleton’s feet are medium sized. Some jewelry lies broken among the bones, a necklace emanating fading transmutation magic near the skeleton’s neck with its chain snapped and two rings split from the inside laying upon the finger bones. The headstone reads to the effect of: ” Here lies our dear Gerald. He helped heal the hole in our family. We forgive you Gerald, for whatever you kept apologizing for.”

r6CMYq8lB3QWq9Wo.description: Nearby is the grave for someone of the same family, killed by a giant while hunting.

RLYqs74PjsFkpOxj.description: The perfectly preserved body of a beautiful youth in fine clothing. Skin still glowing with color, their chest rises and falls with slow restful breaths. They radiate illusion magic.

ami6sotvWOE931bB.description: Attempting to touch the body in any way causes the image to disperse as so much mist, revealing a crumbling skeleton. There is nothing else in the coffin.

NbmMkRsg9qUOWWu5.description: The perfectly preserved body of a beautiful youth in fine clothing, though a grisly wound is clearly visible on their abdomen. They emanate dark necromantic magic.

0frLO42gMg1H4D6D.description: Touching the body causes the eyes of the occupant to snap open and the mouth to open in a silent, vein bulging scream as the color drains from the youth’s skin and the flesh begins to decompose and slough off before your eyes, rotting to nothing seconds after separating from the body. You can see the limbs twitching and trying to move, but as more flesh and muscle rots away, the efforts are weaker and weaker. After almost a full minute of this, the youth can no longer move any of its body except for its eyes and what remains of its face. Its eyes dart around, you can tell that it is intelligent but clearly terrified and in maddening agony. Any healing magic seems to cause it even more pain, and it is impossible to put it out of its misery. Eventually it rots to nothingness.
