FnedC4MRYPACre7J.description: An empty coffin and a cryptic note scrawled in an ancient language.

0eip2ZsUTwSGlD1d.description: A walking stick and a turtledove.

qZpDIUiFf2wyeyVe.description: A corpse found contorted horribly. The lid of it’s coffin is covered in the bloody scratches of a desperate attempt to escape.

3QJ9swyJu0i4LeqT.description: A corpse that is buried face down (a common practice in New England to prevent the dead from rising).

m6m0pKCeLdSLqGdu.description: Cold tea. She asked to be buried in tea and who would stop her when she gets like that?

BOnxIZDQkmIv4zzM.description: A corpse. A perception check shows he is actually alive, but sleeping.

oZU8ylInXWOPqfTj.description: Two corpses entwined in a loving embrace.

cFGn99Axxf4R3pyz.description: A skeleton with its arms folded over the holy symbol of a long-forgotten faith.

kteOtEmKcAx7w6Bx.description: A life sized human shaped porcelain doll, who’s eyes roll open if set up right.

iryLN2wb3neudinl.description: A thief that hid in a coffin and slept there while avoiding authorities, only to wake up having been buried. He’s holding an expensive object (trophy, small statue, large bag of money, etc.) desperately. He seems like he died recently… If he’s dead at all, that is.

oZ8z2AELGbXEay45.description: The corpse’s eyes are not decomposed and follow the character’s movements, the corpse is otherwise completely dead.

XkuG24Hqg8o8cAAK.description: A mace with an old note tied to it that says “for emergencies”.

3KiCeX1wXY3ayT6Z.description: A stethoscope, a book on blood humors, and an empty bottle labeled, “Stobelight’s Purgative Remedy for the Relief of Erysipelas”.

qNF3kUKAFx5f83AI.description: Inside the grave is a tattered backpack containing a hammer, metal stakes, trip wire, a linch pin, and ball bearings. Perhaps this is a hint that there are traps nearby?

StLWMgGuU8y4Lwyz.description: A frayed rope attached to a hammer, that would have fired and “shot” out hundreds of ball bearings. Inside is a note: “Keep looking, you will never unearth my hoard.”

A9XqBjScMHRw6TwM.description: The grave belongs to an archaeologist. There is a small collection of statues of people from a dig site he worked on. The archaeologist never realized, but the statues were once living people turned into these small statues by an evil wizard. Dispel magic or similar spells will cause them to return to human form.

kx73dubTVFGsDF59.description: A leather bound tome which has the inscription Maginifcum Necrorium seared into it. Upon further inspection the leather appears to be human flesh.

doPEvRPKBQzmI39A.description: A single note that says I.O.U. The handwriting is very sloppy.

YK13byN6Z4px60ix.description: The person opening the grave is incredibly surprised when the corpse they are digging up has their head! If the person has not died from fright, they can notice that a mirror has been placed where the head should be in the coffin.

rFlsxFFvOt7SFZ0G.description: A map of the nearby area. There are X’s in certain locations all along the map. Only one of the locations houses treasure, the rest are trapped.

Useless Items You Find with a Failed Inv.name: Useless Items You Find with a Failed Investigation
Useless Items You Find with a Failed Inv.description: One Hundred items you can find in an empty room!Credit: http://dndspeak.com

N2rSMwZnDNhJmBg0.description: A sprung mousetrap, no cheese and no mouse.

e4cPeRFdKKT2OKMu.description: A crumpled shopping list for eggs, milk, laxative, and celery.

NHBndMZlINmDPeDX.description: A bag of hard butterscotch candies, melted together by humidity and time.

pPwYcJfjHCeM5TD8.description: A crusty used handkerchief. No monogram.

JJSJt0K9vCFq36BJ.description: A few scraps of fine fabric, too small to make anything with.

SwmYNgmxPJwA9fwx.description: A pair of eyeglasses, badly scratched.

wQJpIDXgm3I90rq1.description: An old, but clean, pair of socks

HjOOyDemLwh0WnBc.description: A calendar with pictures of landscapes, several years old.

BysE5BiO6o14bral.description: An old, faded receipt from a local tavern.

FfmVg8NKfaBcaQgY.description: Several crayon drawings, obviously made by a child, mostly of horses with wings and rainbows.

QVWNEMAxz7JHoHXP.description: Sixteen ink pens. Only two of them have any ink left.

iSXVyiKSlQkif5gP.description: A ticket stub to a play that was popular years and years ago but fell quickly out of fashion after the playwright was accused of plagiarism.

u4CCq8dyTWm5N358.description: A cookie tin. Upon opening it, you discover that it’s full of sewing supplies.

JyTSnuFDm4MD0CwN.description: A gold piece, but it’s actually chocolate.

ywQ6Q5svSljRaOci.description: A small jewelry box, empty. The label has been removed.

Yoec9ZARVTGfCnwJ.description: A broken picture frame (without a picture)

Hixk9JevZHSfGyGH.description: A rusty butter knife that smells terrible

3fHD7mHgF6g2yCgm.description: A woolly jumper that is more holes than wool.

JHfIqmX1W1Ic0zIf.description: Several feet of yarn, so badly knotted it might take you hours to untangle the mess.

XlfVutdgZ77NH8rY.description: A commemorative plate of the royal wedding.

RMq5FGsqO2qzL3sI.description: A heavily annotated recipe book of foreign cuisine.

QSgFcciLfaxw757u.description: A rock with eyes and a mouth painted on.

32yG810xQdkdVaC6.description: A belt buckle with the prong missing.

tdfQiI5xG58quNVv.description: A shoelace with several tight knots.

BoRh6o3xhq89H7oL.description: Pistachio nut shells. About a handful.

m2KzWP3GMO5VP2LY.description: Flint and tinder in a small wooden box.

ztk1EVtifj2C7Vkm.description: A cheap wax seal stamp, depicting a generic shield shape.

B7gw4QeIW4mhRgXK.description: A small wooden carving of a dog.

6xBsI0IixdoV1fEy.description: A small wooden box of stale tobacco leaf.

vP2u162bKu7zV4Yd.description: A rusty steel and glass syringe.

cBHZjPiuPBOoBAPl.description: A portrait of a plain, unremarkable woman. It looks old enough that the lady is likely long dead.

nHMAoDANnU2ApFKs.description: A postcard from a far away land. The back is blank.

PLFwzeYuu9akmdpU.description: A handkerchief with a knot in it, the owner probably had something important they didn’t want to forget.

siGaTweeVtZnYzFP.description: A small container labelled ‘Dr. Brown’s World Renown Elbow Grease’. It is nearly empty and smells foul.

IqXElDWeD9zgyr72.description: A to-do list written in Infernal.

aGntuqH3YaQmQvFH.description: A chunk of gold ore, but on closer inspection it is actually iron pyrite, also known as fool’s gold.

3a9RueWOCgj0wD5O.description: An old, heavily stained tobacco smoking pipe.

zIdK2YxHXTazz7RV.description: A rag used for polishing metal.

lBumT8X4pPnvNIdJ.description: A pile of old letters, business documents, receipts, and news leaflets stacked under a small model castle made carved from wood.

SiwRq8FPtncLQFu9.description: Sealing wax, along are some strands of ribbon.

wtcJaQdt3CdzDHBf.description: A hairbrush with a few stray blonde hairs.

quFlRkHbnwQCY6vU.description: A dull letter opener, the handle has a griffon at the end with an illegible inscription, worn smooth with time.

6GB3DEANUf0aHF1K.description: A small sketchbook with various poorly executed drawings of everyday things, places, and people. The artist made small improvements as time went on, but even the very last page isn’t really that good.

Lvz1mDmv4b9qlQML.description: Two empty burlap sacks that have an earthy smell of root vegetables and mildew

YKlmsscU7aUNML6j.description: A tankard with the handle broken off; the bottom also looks to be dented, as if dashed against something heavy.

LST9PH4qhYYi6m8b.description: Cracked potion vial, empty. The label is peeling off, but you remember it being a very common brand when you were a kid.

fjyK4yTp8we8rlHA.description: Shattered eyeglasses on a chain that looks at first to be gold but is actually copper that’s been glamoured.

Ls8EpDlvoR9J0cBt.description: A specimen jar of hardened gelatinous cube gel, so dry that it’s become powdery and useless.

beZXkqmsVmHRdz1l.description: A miniature painting of a rose, ruined by a dark red stain.

Cbb9wBDRcows5Lp7.description: A helmet’s face guard. The eyes and mouth holes look a little small for a normal soldier.

TIutHsWdkjxok90P.description: An mostly-empty container of vegetable oil.

bkjTAYR9BjyYOCou.description: An envelope stuffed with cheap woodcut prints of women in various states of undress.

GO10Rm8x90kYVxM0.description: An envelope stuffed with cheap woodcut prints of men in various states of undress.

bVAEXO5UL9OPYCbj.description: A pile of feathers and bone that at one time must have been a small bird.

ssrvkCeGsUgQERSe.description: A pair of large scissors, rusted shut.

VIitKjTjQPjRPK0q.description: A couple of board game pieces, apparently from different board games.

GZLuSAnUi6ZlcVzr.description: An empty bottle of cough syrup with residue at the bottom.

4muGK3r2IASQBiFj.description: A rusty corkscrew with a cork still on the end.

c3aMUg662SoUNzed.description: Half an inch of dust in the bottom of the drawer/chest, rising up when you opened it, making you sneeze.

orKUeI2tFla7AqhW.description: A dead mouse next to a bowl containing the rotting remains of food.

OiXOAnJcPpcBD4Zg.description: A long hank of red braided hair.

Rf0lF2diyC8CkfOf.description: Three small wooden cubes with illegible etchings on all six sides.

EDVnXjwvQlkSHlP8.description: A fragment of a plate armor.

BKjctoskigdlDeNv.description: A half used bottle of hot sauce.

fl1pLPGwq40Np2Rl.description: A moldy shoe with several small holes in the sole.

ZNz1aMxlm5a73sYJ.description: A dusty spider web with fly caught it it. No spider.

q3j90GEvdjEDrqzr.description: A tooth. Looks like a molar.

3aRqoZHbxWcC2mfq.description: A clay pot with a lid, inside is dried fruit with mold growing on it.

SieGU7ccaMdiWDyz.description: A crude ivory carving resembling a woman of uncertain race with very large breasts.

9NXu7mWdfiHrEk7c.description: A piece of paper folded into the shape of a bird.

N1C3L6m1v4KearuU.description: An unwrapped peppermint laying underneath a piece of furniture. It has a hair on it.

04GqR7c0xNGsS6RH.description: Several pieces of paper currency belong to a defunct nation, rendering them worthless.

Useless People You Find On A Failed “Gat.name: Useless People You Find On A Failed “Gather Information” Check
Useless People You Find On A Failed “Gat.description: One hundred different non-helpful people you meet when looking for information.Credit: http://dndspeak.com

lZDCPs2hHONd285P.description: A teenaged ne’er-do-well tried to sell you a narcotic herb. It turned out to be oregano. There’s no law against selling oregano.

WwYgScJe3J2TCPAA.description: You met a very friendly puppy. The owner let you pet it.

1kKBctccZRYiBAPg.description: Two old women insisted that whatever you’re asking about, that’s what’s wrong with kids these days, asking questions like that.

HXrfq7jgeqyYkMnC.description: A little boy said he was lost. His mother was literally right across the street. She apologizes to you for the trouble he’s caused.

vLocShxSq8ZUbLoP.description: You saw someone with a really cool-looking jacket. Nothing matching the description of anyone you’re looking for, you just thought it looked really nice.

9zemfJuUPahVW9lV.description: A street artist was drawing and selling caricatures of people, but when you described what you were looking for, she said she hadn’t seen anything like that.

4JSgrdC2YduLXBgq.description: A man selling sausages in buns said he hadn’t seen anything and grumbled ‘Idle questions don’t pay the bills– sausages do’.

tuXZqQAn9oph1jyP.description: An old man recognized you as a fellow adventurer. He told you his life story and promised he’ll get to the good part soon. He never got to the good part. It was barely even a story, just a list of things he killed and treasure he found. You learned nothing from it.

IZuunmwt3gujsuKb.description: An old woman was having a serious discussion with a dog. It was strange, but it didn’t help your investigation.

qqJnncV9l4L84w1j.description: An old man claimed to have seen what/who you’re looking for. You followed him for nearly an hour. When you finally asked him how long to get to the thing. He couldn’t remember what you were looking for or where you were going.

gmdCQmi9nmXZI3fU.description: A small child asked you why you were ‘dressed funny’. Then she asked you ‘Why?’. And then asked you ‘Why?’. This continued until her mother dragged her away.

6c4eCdl7jCNn4Lq0.description: You are pretty sure you saw a middle-aged lady squat and relieve herself in an alleyway.

hmQtwtf4BKBMpQrd.description: You didn’t find anyone with information, but you did spot a newspaper headline where the word ‘nebulousness’ spelled incorrectly.

CriTpKcvSSO7VVew.description: You found someone with a hooded cloak drawn down over their face, writing on a wall. They ran off before you could ask them any questions. They left behind a drawing that is … inappropriate.

vzRlAHSVo9jk4Wux.description: A woman was handing out samples of a new cultivar of apple. It’s not great. It’s not terrible. Sweet but a little mealy.

QCakwCyWrAX0alPG.description: You found a group of guards on smoke break. They didn’t see whatever it was you were looking for and they suggest you move along quickly.

UPjrYHI6Dldgisln.description: You saw a little old lady playing chess with her great-granddaughter, though she was blind and she had the girl move her pieces for her. This was heartwarming, but it didn’t solve your current problem.

817Mt8BpWMRASePa.description: You saw a cat playing with a dead mouse- it ran away before you got close.

dghqxzuJiih24m1l.description: You saw a cat playing with a live bird– the cat paused to look at you and the bird flew away. The cat glared at you angrily.

erjDr8DhUCdxHEi2.description: You met a merchant from a foreign land selling exotic spices. He didn’t seem to have heard of anything– he barely knows the language, and constantly turned the conversation back to what spices you’ll buy. You think.

GDP2vclLJCOWciWX.description: A woman selling ointments and perfumes from a cart blocked your path and badgered you to buy something. She spritzed you with a free sample and you now smell like lavender.

GGbZgiFCqHSy91Bw.description: A street cleaner offered to let you search the contents of his bin for anything useful. After an hour, you found nothing and now you smell like rotten fruit.

BNDOYgZ9jzqwtaPm.description: You asked a bartender for information. He said they do trivia on Tuesdays, live music on Fridays and ale is half-priced on Mondays. And that’s pretty much it.

3MDF6zh9w5nWlwZq.description: A group of drunk old men waved you over to their table at the local pub, claiming they had information. Each of them gave contradicting stories. As you walked away, they argued over who hoodwinked you the most.

vgSotscEhkhWL57h.description: A well-dressed woman says that she had the object of your search in her shop right now. Once you get in, she began a presentation about how her patented liniment of castor oil, camphor, and 7 secret herbs and resins will cure all your ailments and change your life.

YRgROxtDIt8prF9Q.description: You asked a monk if he’s seen what you’re looking for. He hasn’t, and you interrupted his prayers.

jNzI7yM9E80wK2nB.description: Three old women were discussing possibilities of marriage for their grandchildren. They went quiet and glared at you when you walked past; when they thought you were out of earshot, agreed amongst themselves that you were an example of the type of suitor they hoped to avoid.

rseLhdlKO9kkuh5U.description: A group of children were roughhousing, pretending to be adventurers. They stared open-mouthed as you approached them, as if seeing a celebrity, but acted shy when you came too close.

BvnBPyFbJKcHz5qX.description: You heard a group of girls discussing peoples’ outfits as they observed passers-by. They agreed amongst themselves that they don’t completely hate your outfit. Your mood is significantly brightened, but you didn’t collect any useful information.

A8KQSw8mDlAkqbhE.description: An old woman said she’s sure her nephew knows, but you had to remind her several times why you approached her in the first place. When you arrived at her nephew’s home, he thanked you for bringing the old lady back but didn’t know anything that could help you solve your problem.

0WKYytKyC468yFHx.description: You passed a bard with limp black hair and thick eyeliner. His voice was barely audible above his sad guitar. When you asked him if he’s seen anything he told you that no one sees anything, we are all puppets with our strings cut, washing downstream, waiting to drown.

t9LrhwckJQqTYlKc.description: An excitable elderly man gave you specific and detailed instructions to a building. They sell jars of maraschino cherries, and they didn’t have any information.

E8JgnQsm1iowreIE.description: You saw an old man yelling at a cloud. There are just some regular clouds floating by. He wore an onion tied to his belt and yelled at you for looking at him funny.

utkAjhZ4Ss9830zj.description: A man claimed to have been be abducted by fairies, but the more he revealed the more it’s clear he was just blackout drunk and spent the night in jail.

wgWVfnouMJW8vzxA.description: A toddler insisted on telling you about the snail he found today. Unfortunately, you could only understand about one word in five, and everything you said or did seemed to encourage him.

GULkz6Y6wMXWnugL.description: You saw an elven woman was yelling at a food kart. She wanted her money back because her meat kebab contained meat. Eventually the town guard had to be called in to settle the dispute.

qs9RLKYs4gOVsVgv.description: A handsome young man waved to you. When you waved back and approached him, he seemed confused. He was waving at his friend, who was standing several feet behind you.

JbVeL18vW3YM09hj.description: Someone pointed out a flyer for a laundry service with a clever pun name. When you try telling your companions about it, you can’t remember the name. You feel foolish.

qVtXXebGnqZsaLa6.description: A man was trying to sell eyeglasses on a street corner and he insisted that you needed a pair. You did not need a pair, especially not ones with a great big scratch on the left lens.

FQk2hPvbeRqpJw2j.description: You saw someone with the worst haircut you’ve ever encountered. You briefly forgot what you were looking for as you marveled at just how bad this haircut was. You couldn’t even put into words just how unflattering it was and you become exasperated trying to explain to the rest of the party how deeply disturbed you are that someone left the house looking like that.

mDvsOCccLPRjJhuG.description: You met another party of adventurers. They asked you about answers to their own quest first, and then you asked them about your own. You couldn’t help each other, so they wished you luck on your quest and bid you a sincere goodbye.

zXyqCKfGPxELZPWw.description: You spotted a group of youths who tried to look as innocent as possible as you walked past. You’re not even sure what they were guilty of, they just looked like trouble-makers, but definitely not worth the hassle.

RQKLwdTDDYt5CayU.description: A gnome in the tavern swore he knew all about what you’re looking for but can’t remember anything of use for less than 3 top-shelf drinks. He talked about many things before he fell asleep, none of them pertaining to your questions.

oX8IJrIRvXXpiaW7.description: You asked a normal-looking gentleman if he knew anything, he looked at you wide-eyed, and gasped. ‘You can see me? You can really see me?!’ Before you can answer he’d run away, lost in the crowd. That was the last time you saw him.

ZDJRt3G496fMNfeq.description: A man with a sock puppet introduces it as his wife and talks through her in a falsetto ‘female’ voice. Neither the sock or the man had information relevant to your situation.

j6oWqIeXHaNoxmBt.description: A dwarf was picking lice out of his beard and eating them. He noticed you noticing him and pretended he was just scratching his chin instead.

Nm9XqBK6qBiSjtWS.description: You saw two sweet-looking old people holding hands. It almost made you believe in true love again. Almost.

MWpG3imusaVL3jYQ.description: A citizen claimed to have the all of the answers and went on to explain a conspiracy theory that the government is suppressing the ‘truth’ that the world is cube-shaped for reasons that remain unclear. You left before he could finish.

H6y1jNZoOcTEB1XK.description: As you posed questions to a local merchant, you notice a woman, her hood pulled up against the sun, staring at you unblinkingly. On confronting this suspicious behavior, it is revealed that she was simply staring into space, contemplating dinner.

FvsMogMXx5aMbqEt.description: A child said he knows a very bad secret, but none of the grownups would listen to him. He showed you his father’s cache of wood relief carvings, each crudely carved with images of improbably-proportioned women performing lewd acts. This was a waste of time, they weren’t even carved very well.

GaaFidoB49wPOxq9.description: A six-year-old girl told you she knows something very important, then sagely informs you on the anatomical differences between boys and girls. She wandered off before you could react.

6kGsZRJHMAFiGvMW.description: A street urchin said he had some inside information, but he couldn’t remember properly until you gave him a few coins. He said loudly that you’re a creep for trying to pay him off, and smugly walked away as people stopped what they were doing to stare. When they went back to what they were doing without questioning you, you suspected that you weren’t the first one to fall for this trick. The boy was long gone by then.

fJ4selHBYClnYzv3.description: You felt like the locals were viewing you strangely. Like they knew something you didn’t. When you finally cornered one into an admission, they informed you that your waterskin had been leaking, making it look like you wet your trousers.

TcJENdaQUD3VWTz4.description: A man smiled at you knowingly but refused to answer any of your questions. A helpful passerby told you that this man is the village idiot, and that he always smiles like that.

TcDdiHbmjRiTISji.description: An enterprising street entertainer had no information to share, but for a silver piece he will do a whistle, a tumble, and a fart — all at the same time.

ISufzVYUC5CfkeKm.description: A heavyset woman boldly stated that she doesn’t know and doesn’t care, but if you’d like to earn a copper piece she has four large pots that need to be scraped clean.

Z9sOb3KNEFXC1dHD.description: A foreigner didn’t know anything but dammit, they wanted to be helpful. So they just filled in their gaps of knowledge with anything they could think up.

DKzLISviJ9AKB5Mv.description: A woman was walking strangely, changing her course for no apparent reason. She didn’t appear to be drunk. Turns out she compulsively avoids cracks in the pavement and didn’t have any information for you.

dQFsF1H9YR70MpAP.description: One of the commoners had a really nice butt. Really nice. What were you looking for again?

NQtySwgR8dqRE9gC.description: Vincent Tallman, three gnomes wearing a large overcoat, were trying to pass as a human. It doesn’t seem very convincing but no else seemed to notice. You’re not even sure why they were doing it but they never broke character, insisting that they were, in fact, a perfectly normal human adult. Even when one of the gnomes sneezed and the whole lot of them nearly toppled over.

dDVGTuh9ikTBFTst.description: A shadowy figure lurking in the darkest corner of the shadiest pub in town turned out to be a hat and coat hung up on a rack. That was the closest you got to any useful information.

npVMOzLyg0pa7xZN.description: A young man was sitting in a pillory, a broken lute at his feet. ‘Tasteless Scatological Jokester’ was written on a sign next to him. He did not look repentant. Perhaps even a little proud of himself. He did not know anything.

UzJW1Z7d9IO9dqWy.description: You find a dead body. You must stay as a witness for the local law enforcement, for 2 d6 X 10 min. Relatives eventually show up. The person died of perfectly ordinary natural causes related to a pre-existing medical condition.

C5sQVml9MS5uubHQ.description: A watchman follows you around acting like he thinks you’re a criminal, and frightening off your contacts. When you confront him, he says he’s bored and you looked suspicious, and then wanders off.

M6ot249m28x0mWv2.description: An old man in a tavern who declares that he will lead you to the local tavern with the best gossip so you can ask around there. He takes you out back, walks around to the front, and reenters through the main door. He got a laugh from the regulars.

NScv9g62RUniPl4f.description: “Marv the Magnificent”, a street performer who very loudly and extravagantly boasts to be the most mind-bogglingly talented juggler in all the land. You put off your investigation to watch for a few minutes. He’s ok.

CBZtvvIjs10F96Ys.description: A young girl is throwing pebbles at you. She will follow you for a good ways and will continue to pick up pebbles. The adults who recognize her tell you that you look like the neighbor she doesn’t like. The neighbor happens to be totally ordinary but does look a bit like you.

71rZjq38n9JOMgCo.description: Three kenkus are following each other and mimicking each other with different accents and personalities. They are now mimicking you because you tried to ask them some questions.

bOrGjvQ7I90IOaYs.description: Two people leafing through a manuscript in complex code with elaborate artwork of maps, exotic places, and mysterious artifacts. Each page has a different font, layout, and art style. After eavesdropping, you discover they are a scribe and author picking out a format and font. The manuscript is the scribe’s stylebook filled with nonsense.

0GO4TMpfbXPd748J.description: There is a pair of little girls ahead of you selling flowers for a copper each. They’re just local wildflowers but they’re pretty and they smell nice.

QxyLOYhfCdGD7pKP.description: You discover the barkeep at one of the taverns cheats their patrons by pouring them cheaper wine and beer after they have already had a few. You advise your party not to stay at that tavern.

RRpfmjsM3SEpGS4d.description: An elderly woman who said a relevant keyword to her younger friend. You tried to talk with her, but only got more and more confused as the lady rambled incoherently. Her caretaker explains the lady is a stroke survivor with mild aphasia and uses the wrong words without realizing it.

fBnlNtGdQwFNYa8c.description: A gaggle of homemakers gossiping about property laws, taxes, and which of their acquaintances they suspect of having extramarital affairs while doing laundry.

qvwY3LYh0xgO1Ofz.description: You find a child playing hide and seek. They roped you into the game, so you had to find all of the rest.

BvH8tcpuFTGUOnwi.description: You follow a sparse trail of blood and gore to an abandoned shed. The butcher had given their favorite stray dog some offal, and the dog carried it here to eat.

1BThFs3DTcb4MSk5.description: A group of three philosophers sitting on a street corner debating an obscure moral quandary with great energy and enthusiasm. None of them seem to notice that they all actually agree with each other.

aqQ9jr1wc6CtXnIP.description: What looks like some rags tossed into a corner of an alleyway is in fact a poorly dressed beggar sleeping. He’s upset you woke him up.

BeMXQypfeHZapc6q.description: A man standing outside a building, staring up at the window as a woman throws clothes and other personal items down at him with great vigor. He shouts up at her, demanding that she give him another chance.

d46YvOLDUeIDzBxQ.description: A morose man hiding his drinking habits from his wife. None of his problems are helpful to your quest.

x3oKfIfmnIqfExzx.description: A tall elf walks through the street, accompanied by two half-elf bodyguards. He refuses to speak in Common, and even if addressed in Elvish, wants nothing to do with you. The elf happens to be both dreadfully boring and standoffish.

uHacg6REEDTp65V7.description: A cart with boxes marked with warnings to stay away in several languages. When approached, a halfling woman in a bee keeper’s outfit appears. She’s very annoyed you are disturbing her hives and tells you to buzz off.

gRxBUkvfXqxKqQH5.description: Two crossdressers wanted you to judge whose outfit is better. You found a way to say nice things about both their choices and slipped off when they got distracted.

GCDu0bGflfm7kVLK.description: You see an amorphous cloud of dark smoke coming out of a fireplace. In the smoke you find a dirty chimney sweep, not understanding what is going on.

BAamnskoGmn8aa8F.description: You meet a blind gnome who gives you incredibly specific and confident directions. He is lying, but you don’t notice. When you go to the wrong place, someone helpfully informs you that the gnome is a pathological liar.

3YEq8ltkNLvHZQeK.description: A wizard appears in a puff of smoke, he approaches you and starts to speak, then looks around confused. He looks back at you, mumbles an apology about being in the wrong place, and disappears.

SwDZ0hLQ4SRdW4vn.description: An old woman who makes a horrible grimace at you, but then scuttles away unexpectedly. She thought you were her child and was about to chew you out for your clothes and skipping work, but realized you were someone else when she got a closer look.

OublD4RMxCy0o0GS.description: A pigeon with unusual coloring. You kept trying to get closer to see better, but the flock kept flying away. Eventually the flock mingled with another and you noticed several similarly unusual birds. It must be a common local mutation.

Q2x5R1WiSJv6rRYm.description: A pair of children who accidentally threw a small toy in your direction, which lands at your feet. One runs up to you and snatches it back, calling you a singsong name. His friend, standing behind him, mouths a silent apology to you.

BmtFox5Lnm1AtvkB.description: Upon investigation, a citizen claims to have the information you’re looking for, though they can’t go into detail in public. They try to take you to their ‘hideout’ but you decide to give him/her the slip. The person turns out to be an innocent weirdo whose only goal is to convince you of a hairbrained conspiracy that is provably untrue.

UrfPcjS5HNxbWI7h.description: A halfling who does nothing but brag about his hat.

yQiNLUvmfgGjm2tK.description: A young man crying by the side of the road. They are crying because they accidentally got sand in their eyes a few hours ago and it still hurts.

6ApM0ES1AUxbT3fu.description: A young gnome that keeps making egg-cellent egg jokes. I’m not egg-saggerating, he knows and egg-cessive amount of yolks.

GApjEYHhv2WEE8Vf.description: A person walked by you who smelled incredibly odd. The NPC denies s/he smells at all and tries to leave quickly. You pressed the NPC and discovered that he/she knocked over a bottle of perfume and that s/he has no sense of smell.

0STnPdaemiSnqRaD.description: While conversing with a far-traveled merchant of antiquities, you notice some guards watching you intently, their eyes narrowed, money changing hands. You conclude your business with the merchant and challenge the guards. It is revealed they were betting on whether you’d waste money on the merchant’s junk.

RSey7ojoK1kSAdhx.description: A loud preacher in the nearby town courtyard who was denouncing what he believes to be evils in society for everyone to hear. There was a small crowd listening, some of whom were hecklers. You didn’t learn anything.

e8aVuiVxU8BnyOlK.description: Three young women gossiping and fawning over a handsome local.

5PiiyFb0W1Tp5aGe.description: A young woman ignores your questions as she is too interested in her book.

AwpfcoG5H2r6oChb.description: A man who only likes to talk about his hobbies and shrugs off your attempts to leave the conversation.

xpEsicysY0l7j0tF.description: A farmer observing a hole in his fence where an amorous bull broke through. The bull introduced himself to the cows.

Annoying and Unhelpful NPCs (That your P.name: Annoying and Unhelpful NPCs (That your PCs will probably murder)
Annoying and Unhelpful NPCs (That your P.description: Just because it’s a fantasy world doesn’t mean the inhabitants aren’t idiots.Credit: http://dndspeak.com

l2U8KgxPn3mjU8Mo.description: A bored guard at the western gate of the walled city tells the party that the non-noble entrance is on the southern side. There is no southern gate. “Go ahead, you can’t miss it!”

fHAGXsJ3YaDw3Q9b.description: A shopkeeper who keeps disappearing to the back of his shop for several minutes and keeps returning with the wrong item. “Is this it?”

1wXudnWR3CSplyP8.description: A town crier that only has celebrity gossip with no plot relevance. “The Impresario Raphael Vecchini is rumored to be sleeping with his wife’s sister!”

T9MBHH7T6mq7FCg9.description: A man at the tavern offers valuable information for a drink. He drinks it in one go and passes out. “Zzz”

5jCZMXBfSqizlJq3.description: An Elven scryer whose fetish slowly takes over whatever he is scrying for the party. ”Yes, I can see the leader of the Red Hands. He’s taking off his boots and putting on high heels. His toes are nicely manicured and . . . hrrg, painted with . . . red polish.” (Hopefully not stolen from Oglaf)

XJ4tuXO3tPIK3SPl.description: A talismonger who only has charms for impotence and loudly haggles if the party tries to leave. ”OK, SIR! I’LL SELL YOU THE CHARM TO FIX YOUR IMPOTENCE FOR HALF PRICE!”

eabasAFVh0vjzh8n.description: A thieves guild apprentice hired by the party who picks the wrong pocket. ”Not sure why you call him The Luke, but here’s Luke’s coin purse.”

yJk0PvtIh5NV5zYg.description: A nearly deaf old woman who has the only wagon in town in her yard, who doesn’t actually own the wagon and doesn’t know who does. “No the cabin isn’t for sale, I live here!” “No one can own a dragon!” (H/T to Critical Hit)

Sly7aydIOAFwhc0X.description: An orc mercenary who trips and impales herself on her own sword at the start of the battle. ”For the glory of the-ARGH!”

ji96Nyhgj9id9s1D.description: A captured henchman with long-term memory loss. ”Yeah, we go out and kill Clerics of Bahamut every once in a while, but I don’t remember why.”

ZzLv4BvAHJQagq8Z.description: A bureaucrat who requires immaculate forms in triplicate (with stamps from three other bureaucrats) before assisting the party. ”No, you need to fill out a Form 19D to be eligible to receive a Form 37.”

Wm9417dSMswMK5dx.description: A pirate captain who has no treasure. ”The real treasure is the mateys ye forge along the way.”

yMpzJVeXRDbACumj.description: An uncorrupted prince whose only ambition is terrible poetry. ”I know my father is a withering husk and my brother is a secret Lich, but I’m just really focused on my art right now.”

P7PEu95z5y3ZTh1F.description: A fire breather who gets a coughing fit and accidentally breathes fire on the party. ”Oh sorry! Fire went down the wrong pipe.”

YjQfQo64IayCScW5.description: A stealthy guide whose seasonal allergies kick in as they sneak the party into a heavily guarded area. ”ACHOO!! Damn hay fever.”

EsNBR4pmzjXwQ0b6.description: A fisherman who answers any question with an unrelated big fish story. ”‘Twas a ship blacker than the eyes of that 30 foot shark I caught off Montauk.”

eGxREn0KtCOohZxB.description: A hunchbacked witness who only saw the villain’s shoes. ”They were brown leather. Hope that helps!”

4Wz0ZEKZkyvP0TeG.description: A village blacksmith who only knows how to make and mend cookware. ”I suppose you could hit the goblins with this wok, it’s pretty big.”

GiRb0G6oGC1xBWla.description: A legendary smuggler who doesn’t wash his hands and can smuggle anything that will fit in his butt. ”There’s your Ring of Giant Strength. That’ll wash right off.”

Pstpl17Kl8scbTqi.description: A ship captain who misheard the party’s destination and doesn’t realize the error until they arrive at the wrong port. ”Ohhh, I thought you said Iron Keep, not Waterdeep.”

64KXEZXMyrkNqBMM.description: A caravan master who underestimates travel times by 50 percent. ”I really need a better map.”

7xRbynxVLilKkrYH.description: A cultist who really wants tell the party the 100s long list of the elder demons of their cult. ”Bathsheba begat Beelzebub who begat Ezekiel who begat . . .”

Hqy7qakuUcFVk4hn.description: A barkeep who only speaks and understands an unknown language but understands miming ordering a drink. ”Myrklap kyd ben?”

KWLpbdWBDi09BBPm.description: A barmaid who keeps forgetting the party’s order. ”I’m sorry, I’ll get that mead right out to you.”

XV1NrjURrQQlSmyj.description: A bard who can’t hear the party over the sound of his drumming, including requests to stop drumming. ”SORRY, I CAN’T HEAR YOU OVER THE DRUMS!”

eWReBUSEmyHJ04yn.description: A magical healer who only knows the Sleep spell. ”A good night’s sleep is the best medicine.”

EhWucmH21yo2pEHb.description: A random stranger who when questioned insists they don’t speak Common in flawless unaccented Common. ”Greatest apologies ladies and gentlemen, but I’m afraid I don’t speak Common and certainly cannot understand it. Good day!”

JIOuvqT2dxLxEuji.description: A pair of rival potion sellers who get in a fight with each other over the party choosing one of their stalls, knocking over all the shelves and shattering all the potions. ”You spat in that healing potion, I saw it!”

yKzjrgOzImdQOaFb.description: A librarian who shushes the party regardless of how quietly they talk. ”SHHHHH!!!!!!”

LlLKklnbsfG2Rfni.description: A corpse that has had “Speak with Dead” cast on it that responds to every question with crying about how traumatic death is and asking for a hug. ”The spear stabbed me right in the gut and it hurt so bad!”

UeTup1wK1Om5xYXg.description: A cable ferry operator on the other side of a river who gets distracted when the ferry is halfway and stops pulling the party across the river. ”Come here little bunny, let’s be friends! I’m gonna catch you!”

SwyDN6B1My5xd4bI.description: A merchant selling “health potion bottles” that are just the bottle with no potion. B ”Of course they’re just bottles, I’m a glass blower not a potionist.”

vkLLhsDofmhA2Wtk.description: A rumor monger whose only information is that some idiotic newcomers have come to town and describes the party. ”A pack of rubes showed up in the city and everyone already hates them.”

VbHdTlupXJ9RHD4S.description: An angel who appears at a pivotal battle but leaves to fight an entirely different evil plot. ”Sorry, I’m here to smite Usidore the Blue, not Gragnor Darkheart. Good luck though!”

AEQGtq3mYcTfoC64.description: A hailed ship that misreads the party’s message and departs without stopping. ”We don’t need rescue. Have fun at your beach party.”

rgez5K7IuwUbCZqz.description: A Paladin ally that refuses to use stealth or cunning. ”Ronan the Accuser, I will have my vengeance!”

nJZSQeKIKYdjznwY.description: An herbalist who offers cheap rates on potions, but will need 3 months to journey to where the needed herbs are and get back. ”Eight potions coming right up. Just need to ascend the Fangtooth Mountains, cross the Brackhaven Moors, and delve into the Caves of Madness.”

niNb3HXUZxJNe1yu.description: A majordomo who helpfully schedules them for their master’s next available appointment in 2 years. ”You’re lucky we had one available so soon!”

M89G1PUSPpcloc6X.description: A dragon who obsessively reorganizes her massive hoard and can’t talk until it’s done. ”I wasted 500 years organizing by value, but now I’m thinking I should order by material type.”

SyxcVQ65HKyKepGJ.description: A pack of street urchins who cheer or boo the party incessantly wherever they go and at all hours. ”YAYYYYYYY!!!!”

t9vpDfAWatoPlVwL.description: A tailor who lies to the party that the palace only admits visitors who wear entirely sheer clothing to ensure no hidden weapons. ”It’s ok, the whole court is basically naked.”

DvJyTFo6coAZrAsN.description: A ferrier who only shoes donkeys due to a grudge against a horse who kicked him. ”You may be wondering why they call me Smashface The Ferrier.”

xhRL5Dm3jsG3M3I7.description: A goblin artificer who only sells hand buzzers, squirting flowers, and extendo-grabbers for retrieving stuff from the floor. ”Good joke!”

AdZ4w00201phufdf.description: An exotic creatures dealer who claims to have a baby dragon, but it’s clearly a very fat iguana with fake wings. ”What do you mean you want your money back?”

7VzWFp7Ft7Pc93Mi.description: A courier who delivers an urgent, cash-on-delivery message to the party that’s intended for someone else. ”Lady Xiao says she loves your jade silk kimono. That’ll be two silver coins, please.”

pOBdvFTPDuGKXNet.description: A man in the stocks who claims to be a dethroned king and offers great riches if freed. He leads the party back to his “castle,” a farmhouse, and offers them bags of lead coins minted by his “kingdom.” ”The Kingdom of Steve shall not soon forget your service to the throne!”

L3PbgGn9OF8i9Ctn.description: A customer in line ahead of the party that asks to see every item and then decides not to buy anything. ”Can you check in the back?”

W103UKfIaPexkmsx.description: A giant who only allows the party to pass over a bridge if they can answer his riddle. He has forgotten the riddle. ”What walks on three legs-no, that’s not it.”

NHHfy8CZ6Vxt9I4d.description: A carriage driver who makes a lengthy detour to retrieve his forgotten lunch from home. ”Just making a quick stop.”

IemYMmTjwO7sZqVB.description: A bridgekeeper roused from sleep who promises to lower the drawbridge. He disappears inside the gatehouse and does not return. ”Yeah, yeah, hold on.”

RVMeQgbUHyBR2Okp.description: An artisan named Gary who created an object the party is investigating. Gary does not exist and was invented by the other artisans as a scapegoat. ”Classic Gary!”

pLDGp6Y20a0Fy5Tp.description: A fortune teller with a crystal ball who only shows the PC leaving her shop unhappy. ”I see you storming out and calling this a scam.”

zW9VbroZOYHqZzd3.description: A shopkeeper who won’t accept high value coinage due to counterfeiting concerns. ”Sorry, we don’t take gold coins. Too many fakes.”

K08VcmWAo9Yt7Qvv.description: A pair of horse riders who stop to chat in the middle of a narrow bridge, blocking traffic. ”Hail Akbar, what news? No, I can talk right now.”

VaYjTUbGvfLuEtZd.description: A villager who warns of a scourge descending on the village. They lead the party to a wall that has been graffitied by local teens. ”This used to be a safe village.”

hfFlcFxbtDQmwCRW.description: A trader selling a treasure map. The treasure is real, but months’ travel from the party’s current location. ”Sure it’s in Turmish, but it’s free for the taking!”

vytOdqeiv5ROkGSC.description: A thief being chased by the authorities who tosses the stolen goods to the party and disappears. ”Catch!”

wAw5dmFAydqpjtPz.description: A gambler who keeps adding new rules and exotic bets to the game, making it impossible to follow. ”It’s the second en banc round, so you can double your trifecta bet, or go for a lateral sidebar.”

MYuCbDa9uLBRFX11.description: A priest who won’t stop swinging around his smoking censer, spreading noxious smoke everywhere. ”I will pray to Ilmatur to heal that cough.”

NkWFxMrrPa8wo8J0.description: A falconer who sends the party’s message via his falcon, only to have the poorly trained falcon fly away to freedom. ”Well, he’s not coming back.”

T3tw9YRIqBwgtpLt.description: A sailor who gets violently seasick all the time. ”Sorry Captain, I’ll swab the de-BLARGH!”

RaZD3crRKce11nFV.description: A cook whose entire menu isn’t available but doesn’t inform the party until they order something he doesn’t have. ”Fresh out of that.”

j64TSlJfDb482ClN.description: An official who pockets the party’s bribe, then doesn’t hold up their end of the deal. ”What money?”

4WsaG9NMX1Z5itlB.description: A beggar who isn’t happy with whatever aid the party offers and throws it back at them. ”I said a turkey leg, not a ham hock!”

k3FOl2fuOlUiTA3s.description: An incompetent shepherd who has blocked the road with sheep for several miles. ”Sorry, they kinda do their own thing.”

z9wZ9UI3UjfOJTVA.description: A wizard who keeps accidentally casting Prestidigitation when talking with his hands and lighting the party’s clothes and hair on fire. ”Does anyone smell smoke?”

XhMkwen2ZwHWwQzo.description: A star-struck, barefoot and scrawny peasant youth who pledges their life to fight alongside the party and will not be dissuaded. ”I am but a poor peasant girl, who weighs 90 pounds soaking wet, who’s never been in a fight, cursed with hemophilia, but . . .”

tkFIcqLSg6vIIc7k.description: An improv troupe that appears one by one, dressed as a king and insisting that the party swear fealty to them and only them. ”We are Improv Faerun and – please stop booing!”

eOyMclwZuXowEuwQ.description: A noble who never remembers the party, no matter how many quests they do for him. ”Greeting, I am Lord Dunsmuir, it’s nice to meet you.”

mjYb4UFaOqyyCFGM.description: An abandoned baby who cries loudly whenever not being sung to. The more vulgar the song, the quicker the baby stops crying. ”WAAAAHHH!!!!”

1b1itUJBPAyGRExT.description: A slaver who keeps making cliche office humor jokes. ”Workin’ hard or hardly workin’?”

w0Q4adYlf9H2lZDG.description: A missionary who is frustratingly vague about the tenets of his religion. ”We believe in doing what is right and uhh, doing right.”

7IZAZ26z4GWbSJjg.description: A barbarian who shouts “FIRE!” in an urban area and leads the party to a tavern hearth fire. ”Come quick! FIRE! Fire bad!”

AxS7W8WZIVl3sYt7.description: A woman who begs for help rescuing her baby who is clearly a man with a long-haired wig. No women’s clothes, no makeup, just a wig and fake-ass voice. ”My baby!”

OnBhT4kvv96ZGx0P.description: A kobold who insists a party member’s weapon belongs to him. ”Two-hand sword belong to me!”

N6sBGHa6foBi1wsw.description: A gnoll who laughs loudly at whatever the party says, even if it’s not funny. ”Hahahahah”

cdPEA153l8K1qvnR.description: A troubadour who wants to follow the party and sing of their deeds, but keeps getting the details wrong. ”Omar the Paladin smote the dragon with a longbow.”

qri8tWx0WuOBU3zG.description: A devil who has negotiated a deal with the party, but realizes she left her infernal quill that will make the deal binding back in the Nine Hells of Baator. ”I’d lose my horns if they weren’t attached to my head. Wait here for a few years?”

2tAccFRlVBz1WB4s.description: A suitor who keeps showing up and interrupting important social or combat encounters to profess their unrequited love for a member of the party. ”Adriel, I know this battle still rages, but will you marry me?”

kRYl8494n8qT7NGY.description: A child who insists one of the party is their parent, even though they are the wrong race or species. ”Daddy?”

UKL2OGKUFtAp7Nd4.description: A merchant who accidentally orders X cases of an item instead of X items for the party. ”Well, you gonna pay or not?”

4yUPlYkuODbnShwl.description: A stray animal that follows the party and pees on their shoes whenever they stop moving. ”What’s that soun-HEY!”

sSpTaFn9RFtJZjBt.description: A gentleman who demands satisfaction but insists on extremely odd or unwieldy dueling weapons. ”Very well, we meet with woks at dawn.”

V0EIdLecrrpEH7WG.description: A duellist who challenges a party member to a duel at a dramatic but inconvenient time and location, but fails to show up. ”Guys, I don’t think he’s coming.”

eu6u4l8FcPldYK83.description: A monk who wants to demonstrate their power by catching a swing of a partymember’s sword with their bare hands. Cries out in pain when the sword cuts off their hand. ”Why would you do that?!”

K6AqF2MSY8b9C82A.description: A crime lord who mumbles like a bad impression of The Godfather and is annoyed of asked to repeat himself. ”I sdidnlikyrtnfvcd.”

UEHeZp9iAuSnwCh1.description: A princess who insists the party address her through an intermediary who keeps subtly messing up their message. ”The Princess accepts your offer to rid the kingdom of the demi-rich. She also doesn’t care for the bourgeoisie.”

NP4bicNyI3xb6aLD.description: A king who takes way too long to get to the point. ”So I tied an onion to my belt, as was the style at the time. This was back when the kingdom was mostly onion fields, as far as the eye could see. Back then you could see a punching Judy show for a copper and still have change leftover for a turkey leg.”

QIjG9L9vkSOxX2W7.description: An adventurer who constantly tries to one-up the party’s achievements. ”Oh yeah? I once fought two dragons.”

aDhKXeJS0cJZQdN3.description: A prophet who warns of a great threat that the party has already defeated. ”A dark figure threatens the realm. She wears a red cloak with the sigil of Ixumat, like the one you’re using as a tablecloth.”

ilt3qNxXcOgxh2Wx.description: A Goliath who refuses to wear pants when speaking with the party. ”Stop staring, my eyes are up here.”

A5UnNoBJSJDZkuPj.description: A BBEG who is amenable to stopping their evil plot, but can’t quite grasp why it’s considered evil no matter how well explained. ”But I’m not killing them, the legions of the damned that I summoned are. Necromancers don’t kill people, undead kill people.”

N9hYNC4hpkfzJ88y.description: A pacifist who disapproves of the party using violence. ”Attacking the Slyntar the Blood Thirster makes you just as bad as Slyntar the Blood Thirster.”

9QHyhlLdNv8iOJdZ.description: A brooding lone wolf who keeps loudly interjecting what a brooding loner they are into the party’s conversation with someone else. ”I don’t want to talk about my tragic backstory!”

XWxHbPsr1xUWsMYp.description: A min-maxed NPC who criticizes a similar player’s abilities. ”You use Cloud of Daggers instead of Scorching Ray? Psh, noob.”

ENyiCJY2wI3ZqaM0.description: A dying hero whose requests get more complex and burdensome as their extended death goes on. ”Promise me my funeral procession will have 500 elvish ladies, each wearing a crown of golden peonies, accompanied by a 40 person orchestra.”

FRXtnfJGYVLpJXxW.description: A condescending hireling who keeps comparing the party to better adventuring parties they’ve worked for. ”QuestEx would have cleared this dungeon without a long rest, but hey, not everyone can be QuestEx.”

9fzTaHnmbc7AAl1j.description: A cat breeder who is concerned the level 1 party will hurt demand for his cats by killing all the rats in town. ”Rattin’s my business, how about you keep movin’.”

iDET0sxVj4ZIbKHs.description: An artificer who sets aside an alchemy experiment to talk to the party. The experiment starts to smoke more and more, but the artificer insists it’s fine. Eventually it explodes. ”Did you do an apprenticeship in alchemy? No? Then don’t worry about it.”

LALWs3dTcSCedlXz.description: A party of adventurers who keep undercutting the party in quest negotiations. ”Free market at work, bro.”

Carousing Events.name: Carousing Events
Carousing Events.description: Over one hundred different things that can happen to your players during a night of drinking.Credit: http://dndspeak.com

Bq6Jl45QzWxdpwII.description: You wake up on a throne wearing a crown of twigs, surrounding you are 30 sleeping goblins.

ivXGLvDu9Z9PFPFe.description: You cracked a tooth. There is a hunk of metal in your pocket with a set of tooth indentations in it. It was a piece of jewelry worth 1d100gp, now it is somewhat devalued.

r8mE9M9YbWv9G8LU.description: A potion sits on your nightstand as you awake. It is labeled drink me!

fpRhASTAS433uI3Y.description: A familiar waits at your bedside for you to wake, and refuses to leave your side. You have gained a new/additional (if you already owned one) familiar. See the list of 100 familiars to roll what familiar it is.

aFVLxrshLVPjLtio.description: You wake up in a bed. Floating in the middle of a murky pond. You can see your gear at the edge of the pond 100 meters away. You also see a large shadow swimming beneath the surface of the pond.

70sSGy12IVU7650w.description: You find a holy book in the dresser drawer of your inn room. On the very first page hastily scrawled is the innkeeper is a vampire, with a splatter of blood next to it. The innkeeper is not a vampire.

GRhKw7JIplbqfxiT.description: You wake up in a bed. Your belongings are on the nightstand next to it. You’re surrounded by dense forest in all directions.

jKGO8KaNkKaiCdLc.description: You awake in a regular looking tavern room with a note taped to you, it reads: Beware of mimics. You notice your pack with all your belongings on the floor beside the bed. The door is the mimic.

GpLGM6k2WID1u53z.description: You stayed up all night. You are very sleepy.

n6z8ETBVMm9Q0yxU.description: You wake up snuggled up with an ogre in a jail cell, and a massive headache. You’ve arrested for disorderly conduct and ordered to sleep off your inebriated state in jail. The guard comes up to the cell door, chuckling to himself as opens it up to let you out. He shows you a contract you’ve signed, in which you promised the ogre named Gutsplitter that you would bring him home to his mountain.

ZyI5xiWImpP6syRV.description: You wake up face down in a next of giant centipedes, surrounded by mountains of copper coins.

s44A70o68wFniDya.description: You wake up in a strange gold room, with diamonds and coins the size of your entire body. You suddenly feel the entire room jostle upwards, and a dreaded feeling of vertigo overcomes you. You realize it’s not the coins and diamonds that are big… You’re the one that’s smaller!

enD3P2nZbmAzrtEV.description: You wake up in the temple of town, with a grumpy old priest dabbing down your forehead as he mumbles things about the ‘youth of these days, not knowing when to stop!’

f3SGpwMOrtzckJaH.description: You wake up on top of the enormous statue of the king, in the middle of the square, with your underwear wearing on your head. There’s green paint all over your hands, and when you look down you see people pointing at you and the king’s ass in utter shock.

dh7X152ytTFclqCg.description: You wake up on a cold stone table; your naked body shakes from the icy touch. As you begin to get up a sharp pain comes over your chest. You ever so slowly shift and lift yourself up and as you look down you see there is now a long, red, thick scar over where your heart is. You look around the room and see demonic runes, bones, tiki torches and that the walls of this room are the sides of a small cave. The exit to the cave is just ahead, you spot your items there in a pile, the light of the early morning is just beginning to pierce the cloudy sky. Something sinister happened last night; you pray it will not come back to haunt you.

0THlCq21Rmo8AKor.description: You wake up & realize that half your gear is missing. In your hand is a crumpled piece of paper with a badly drawn treasure map on it.

1jYGWcPqhAwDVfAN.description: You may have lost the drinking contest, but you have gained the respect of a dwarven adventuring party

RjAHyCMHsdfsh1Tz.description: You overhear some other patrons at the tavern plotting a crime. Join them, stop them, call the city guard, or It’s none of your business.

86NXbbxCI1uh4fPn.description: The next day 3 people start fighting over you. They seem to be arguing over which one saw you first & the promises you made last night.

nOvPB8iRoYR8TOgU.description: You wake up under a tree at the outskirts of town. There is a person next to you. They gently place a finger under your chin to tilt your head so you’re eye to eye. Then in a very calm voice they say ‘challenge accepted’. Without another word they wander into the woods. A minute later, you see a dragon take flight, flying away from the town.

GhSmCFyfy0FG2iMb.description: You wake up in a summoning circle, surrounded by robed figures. The apparent leader shouts ‘All hail lord Azzagogth’.

LCrqhdozVfhLGYsD.description: You feel a slap on your face. ‘Hey! Wake up and focus! It’s go time. The boss is about to blow the doors. Go go go!’

BK54znCsjXa3ClfV.description: A faint breeze caresses your naked buttocks as you try to figure out how to untie yourself from the flagpole.

ETLI9fiS5ZJtv8r7.description: You wake in the sewers, sitting upon an over-sized and terribly shoddily made throne, with a tribe of Kobolds bowing and supplicating before you. Somehow, you’ve become Kobold Royalty.

yE40yGstFCT5gB9D.description: You wake to the sounds of a high-pitched voice reciting a list of your failures. Upon inspection, the voice is coming from a copper bracelet (which has a beautiful green patina). Turns out you lost a game of chance at a local tavern, and this sentient item was transferred to you. It’s only function is to loudly and incessantly speak upon your failures (which it knows all of).

XsV7uuJeqhgdZrKm.description: You wake up face down on the street, just outside where you are staying. You don’t know how long you’ve been sleeping on your arms but both of them have gone to sleep entirely and you cannot manipulate either, only swing them limply.

Glp7LsAb5gsI5arD.description: You wake up to find the wife/husband of a very important mob boss in bed with you. You suddenly hear heavy pounding on the door, telling you to unlock it at once!

z8UBjNEsQDRSOk8Q.description: You wake up on a cold marble slab surrounded by candles with two men in robes standing vigilant over you.

acaezN3pUG3jcOYO.description: You wake up on the floor of what seems to be a kennel surrounded by snoring war dogs.

lIWkQj85LnjHv68Y.description: You wake up with a headache, but everything else seems in order (DC perception check to notice if a magical item of your was replaced with a mundane replica).

RCeZvzqEbqS57Dhi.description: You wake up in the Underdark, somehow.

iuDGjUUqW1HPcVPh.description: You wake up and find that you have a powerful curse on you. Turns out you cursed out a wizard last night, which in hindsight was probably a bad move.

yB3GNcIZBOyLRko1.description: You wake up in a bed that isn’t yours in a town you’ve never heard of. Apparently, you seduced a wealthy aristocrat who took you back to their mansion. They were also very drunk, and might need to dispel a scandal with you at the center.

pHutN7f2FE2xxwJw.description: You wake up to the other side of your bed empty, as well as all your stuff gone, including your clothes. Leaving the inn, you begin to see a trail of your things leading to the town fountain, where the rest of your things lay soaked at the bottom of the fountain.

si8X80ZW5ncM2sEK.description: You wake up in the pigpen of a farm 6 hours away from the place you were carousing.

0Wq8vij1wRtZMYBG.description: You wake up with 1d6 more tattoos than you had before.

8RCQUMeqr9fWNpqO.description: You wake up with a new magic item. Its original owner will want it back.

0i1WP5yFWgGuV6lA.description: Everything seems fine until you open your backpack and discover someone’s complete skeleton inside.

k2j0Nt9O7KO8uz62.description: Your favorite weapon has been switched with a very similar one, likely grabbed by mistake. The name of the real owner is on the handle.

PPc6SN2xgwpF9hNT.description: A strange, ethereal figure stands above you as you wake. It says “thank you for all that you have done for us” and vanishes with no further explanation.

umGK17FVHJf6cG8c.description: You awake naked in the tavern broom closet cuddling the owner’s dog.

omZEvnfiaVUPvylM.description: You awake in an attic, the resident of which, a rather lonely ghost, you have apparently befriended.

QZaLPBX4Cay76vVc.description: You awake missing a prized/sentimental possession; gambled away in a street game where it has since been traded many more times.

VLif4b9nhlkVU289.description: You awake in a strange house, chained to the bed. Someone comes in and feeds you breakfast with an adoring, unbreaking stare. It seems you’ve won an admirer.

B9dfTHNEock0OAwU.description: You awake at the bottom of a ravine, covered in what smells like duck fat. Scavengers circle overhead.

hr8VYYGJe9wW3YyQ.description: You wake up on a boat on a foggy stretch of water, you are wrapped tightly in canvas that has been stitched closed. Your feet are tied together to a large-ish rock.

zmyTEzTI0RyyBxRo.description: You wake up with the skin below your waist, between your legs (if you have legs) red, swollen and blistered. Your speed is halved for three days.

R6qJmcQ5z5FydWBH.description: You wake up covered in what you can only assume is fox-urine, and covered in bloody chicken feathers.

OiJDca06iW48bxT8.description: You wake up missing your favorite tooth, two black eyes, a broken nose, and possibly one or more broken ribs.

MfdFSd0xWyenlxaZ.description: A short while later you find a slightly battered, scented, high quality paper card attached by a string to a small, finely wrought, ornate key. On the card, in embossed lettering, is the name and address of a wealthy person, as well as a handwritten phrase, in excellent penmanship, reading: ‘You were wonderful. Come see me again.’

kcYJYOM3ccD3h8ih.description: You think you broke, or very badly twisted, your ankle at some point, and your neck and shoulder isn’t doing so hot either.

2WZtmGSvgg9r4mue.description: Your pinky finger on your dominant hand is definitely broken, and the skin of both of your hands are heavily cut and abraded. Several small shards of pottery need to be fished out of the wounds.

Q7TdrbdBqbhY6c0F.description: Your skull is bleeding; as is typical of head-wounds, it bleeds profusely and makes the area you woke up in look like the scene of a murder. The wound will definitely require stitching.

OANYjCsUCeHm9G2F.description: You realize, at some point in your revelry, you wound up the proud owner of a pumpkin farm somewhere in the countryside. Most of the gold you had on hand is gone, replaced with a crinkled roll of parchment recording the transfer of title.

5AxJvaSF8ouRbN1M.description: You wake up with 500 platinum and a warrant with your picture, but the name says, ‘Unknown thief 3 of 5’. Four other unknown thieves have their portraits hanging in the tavern.

qc1nIoe7uCosnhWY.description: You wake up to the sound of a trumpet. All around you are dwarves in different states of nakedness and everyone has an instrument. Seems like you joined the Orchester.

1AVI2pTb7fRQhlCE.description: Someone yells at you to wake up, it seems you challenged a Guard to a duel at noon, you have 15 Minutes left, and you’re still drunk.

2BVRG8lIlwji1llw.description: You find yourself in a cage outside the city wall. You have no memory of how you got there or what for.

9l5iNujdWV9rvnLE.description: As you wake up you discover a shiny new tattoo on your chest, it glows and it seems to be some kind of rune.

wQ82YQUIVvzk0zBl.description: You wake up and learn that you have adopted two things: A boy called Ismael and a Pig.

cNz7ZUPIySLLCgad.description: You wake up in a tent full of sleeping, apparently drunk Goblins, there’s also a bounty on their heads. But all your weapons are gone.

4xrwvai2ZCmOOl53.description: You wake up from the sound of the trees moving in the wind. With shock you realize you’re atop a giant old oak tree, the tallest in the forest.

n9o3PF8UxkrteMjk.description: The sound of a Sergeants screams wakes you, looks like you volunteered in the army while you were drunk.

pc32BXYLeo6WnsSr.description: You wake up in the safe of a bank- gold, silver and 2 sleeping dwarves surround you.

yxAfd3Xmwe7W7c7Q.description: You wake up in the local mages library having apparently drunkenly solved a complex magical mystery.

MNYInWK7qryTPHvf.description: You wake up in a jail cell from a kick in your ribs. The world is fuzzy, your head is pounding, and a large guard squats over you and whispers ‘So you like other people’s wives do ya?’

knv25xnqeAgqCdED.description: You wake up half in a ditch of stinking greenish water. Something is crawling up your leg inside of your clothes then it bites your inner thigh…

0WXIGh1Yli2kZo4h.description: You wake up in a tavern bedroom in a cozy feather bed. All of your possessions are there and you seem to have gained 354 extra gold pieces and a note that says ‘Thanks, you were fabulous.’

bRgcKq6UXIEVMot9.description: While out partying, you broke something expensive, but a local noble you were out with got caught with the blame and the bill. They plan to get payback one way or another.

AHhDK2kYG6KFG5Lz.description: You committed a minor act of vandalism in a public place. Half the people you encounter are amused, the other half are offended.

AsXXQ0fYjwiHdUry.description: You impressed local bandits with your willingness to injure yourself to get laughs. They like you.

zITvEQPT9jBoec43.description: You swore an oath to perform a great deed on behalf of a local church. In their temple. Standing on their altar. During a ceremony.

9URBZwjlKqSQvStg.description: You committed an act of public indecency while trying to retrieve a ferret from your trousers.

WySfSyTUjOUaGPXM.description: You invested all your gold in a local loser’s get-rich-quick scheme. It’s actually not a bad plan, but he has his shirt on backwards and he’s perfectly sober.

B0Fsqdh0jJbMU868.description: You traded clothes with a beggar. It was a generous impulse, but now you’re developing a rash and you forgot to retrieve an important personal item from a pocket.

thAmZNKR1nD7OquE.description: You wake up, and a half-full spittoon or chamber pot is attached to your hand by a powerful magical glue. A little searching in the filthy contents may or may not reveal a vial of solvent.

Nvmau0XjiMrsCT6y.description: You have three new tattoos, one of them is in a place that never sees sunlight. What are the new tattoos?

Sn7n3ZNlLJ0QsvTl.description: You find a wedding ring (worth 1d10x1d100 gp) on your finger. An inventory of your coin-purse may or may not reveal that you paid for the ring somehow. The inscription is your name plus the name of someone you don’t know. Even after you take off the ring, you may or may not notice shadowy people following you.

SPpdvUnZ5XHc5J0r.description: You wake up with a terrible headache, and are inside a closed casket turned upside down in an abandoned warehouse. A note that reads, ‘Be more careful next time’ may or may not be stuffed in your shirt pocket, and you may or may not know who signed it and put it there.

GAYG3yLdTu6i0UWc.description: The webs of your fingers and toes have been stitched together with either artful, elegant, and tiny stitches, or crudely glued together with magical glue. Has your mouth suffered the same fate?

tmQmMzG8iZS2sSRV.description: Your pants are on your arms and over your head, and your shirt is on your legs. Your socks and boots are laced up on your hands and a stuffed horse’s head is crudely attached by string onto your underwear (and backside). Something unspeakable and foul is inside the stuffed head.

Dceoa16glUKqkNU8.description: Your mouth tastes like the sole of your boot; then you realize your boot has been stuffed in your mouth while you sleep. A dog dropping wrapped in a lovely pink silken bow has been artfully deposited inside.

cRgRMP858xz4PwQ4.description: A half eaten box of fancy chocolate in a heart shaped box falls off your chest onto the floor. A dead rat, clutching the remains of nougat may or may not reveal the chocolates are poisoned.

u2dXuUhntFxHCrBf.description: You commissioned a painting of yourself, in a state of undress, astride a horse and leading a charge into battle. The finished painting, and a very expensive bill are somehow waiting for you outside. It may or may not be a very good likeness, or painted magically.

eNBaJWi4KqgdloFk.description: You wake up and discover your skin is now blue, if you skin was previously blue it is bright orange.

rxfRdoMV1Fy1wskS.description: You wake up and can no longer speak common.

8ZPrH7MdAqAC9pJa.description: You wake up with cuffs on that prevent you from casting more than a cantrip, a note says they will be removed after you apologize – no name.

F8KYOrqr86L9Bdhp.description: You wake up naked in the pews of the nearest temple.

wrXfndTzQbeqTEne.description: You wake up and discover you can’t lie without sneezing, wearing a disguise results in hiccups.

Rj1cfiD4fZxdvc6S.description: You open your eyes to see the world has been inverted, your dexterity rolls are inverted until you next sleep.

VdMzHQmM23NTAu6H.description: You awaken to find your self naked with a headless chicken in the middle of a demon summoning ritual. If you read the demons name aloud, he will be summoned and expect payment.

CE53E3gLvqMTgFKs.description: You wake up sitting at the table of a regular house with a hot beverage in front of you and a sweet old lady asking how good was your night. The old lady will make small talk and offer food in case you want some.

e8MXNoZRajmEMCfs.description: A dog pulling your clothes wakes you in the middle of a cornfield, at the end of a freshly made winding path, and leads you towards a barn house, where a farmer demands you pay from all the crops you stepped on.

MywVH6S0NgRPiSvK.description: You come to your senses strapped to a pillory in the middle of a spanking/whipping session, ran by the town guards meant to discipline and punish you from all your drunken adventures. After a while, you’re fined 2d20gp and released if you pay, if not, you’re left in the pillory for 1d4 hours, or until someone else pays. Lose 1d6+1 hp.

afGGG0kvfFKIZUeM.description: You wake up covered in blood, scrapes, cuts, and with a wobbly tooth. Your companions tell you that you stumbled in late last night yelling ‘You should have seen the other guy!’. Examination of your belongings reveals you are now 100GP richer. It seems you may have gotten into a fight with, or possibly mugged, somebody quite well off. There’s a heavy knock on the tavern door, and you can see guards outside.

FQr8QPHPBiahSDFe.description: You awaken with an entire small tavern’s worth of people crammed into your bed in various states of undress. You’re sticky with spilled beer, somebody has drawn a huge moustache on your face in soot, and you have a horrible feeling that one of your new friends missed the chamber pot in the middle of the night. There is vomit in your left boot, and the right is missing entirely.

ksLKL0DEjdXFaVZX.description: You’re beaten awake by a twig broom. Looks like you made somebody else’s front room your bed for the night. The floor is piled with turnips, which you seem to have collected – your shirt is several feet away and stuffed full of the things. The house owner picks a turnip up, throws it at your head, and yells at you to get out.

lOthRUcLahsxEPY4.description: Several hundred rats surround your bed, staring unblinkingly at you. They will follow you, and obey simple commands, but only until sundown, when they disappear back into cracks and pipes and alleyways.

riUGFL7M9BCbD94R.description: You’re shackled to an oar in a galley.

DiiewzevxWvQ0GPc.description: You awake with a letter in your hand, and the guilty memory that you swore on your life that you would deliver it. Unfortunately, you can’t remember who it was for.

d7BcPJKWSO6uJMj6.description: When you stagger downstairs into the tavern, a burly female half-orc grabs you and throws you down into a seat. Apparently you won an arm-wrestling contest against her last night, and she wants a rematch.

F1XwNbwyS9C0Ilpy.description: You don’t remember any of your exploits last night, but the town bards apparently do. Worse, the song one of them wrote about you has become a comic hit and is being sung in every tavern in town within the week. Every time you hear the song, the details get wilder and wilder. You have no idea which of them are true.

Z9baYqagnCeqlbdm.description: Somebody has shaved off all your hair. A quick check around your body reveals that, yes, they shaved all of your hair.

KhhfGt9DCMWZU5cm.description: When you go downstairs, all the residents of the tavern greet you with shouts and open arms. Seems that you jumped up on the bar last night and proclaimed ‘drinks are on me!’. You’re now quite a lot poorer.

zH7YJB4L1NoXgEno.description: An angry innkeeper is demanding payment for an entire barrel of ale. Seems you got tired of your drinking horn, and decided to go straight to the source. That would explain why your clothes are completely soaked and stinking of stale beer.

j7GfPXpprHzejKw9.description: You bought a horse. She’s on her last legs, knock-kneed, toothless, swaybacked, and bad-tempered. She takes an instant dislike to you.

GokpKxeDlaBconMc.description: You’re woken by jostling. When you open your eyes, you’re on a sedan chair being carried through a cheering crowd. Around your neck is a gold chain. In the distance you can see a stage with a table, and on the table is a feast. You’re now mayor of the town. It’s a pity that the town has a tradition of sacrificing its mayor after a year in office to placate the monsters that live beneath.

wdxpArljb271Pp4M.description: You wake up face down on the street, just outside where you are staying. You don’t know how long you’ve been sleeping on your arms but both of them have gone to sleep entirely and you cannot manipulate either, only swing them limply.

Drunken Boasts.name: Drunken Boasts
Drunken Boasts.description: One hundred different boasts for your characters and npcs to drunkenly tell their party!Credit: http://dndspeak.com

PH9YRx7pspTEBMQJ.description: “I once shouted the fire off of a burning orphanage.”

nnNHe9oPt5LCyKev.description: “I once killed 7 men in one stroke.”

zCiRs3n5VmOatmc3.description: “I once killed 7 flies in one stroke.”

ItpTapKvQiRlHvwz.description: “I once lived for a year in a barren desert solely off of juice which I squeezed from rocks.”

YR4znSQwqUJbvQFp.description: “I once killed a red dragon with fire.”

8uWDElTyV9Zwoug9.description: “I stole a kiss from a nymph in a hidden grotto, cold as the moon she was, but twice as lovely.”

DPZFtQ7vPr2ddlHJ.description: “I once beat an ogre in an arm wrestle.”

k4UitoVrtS3gJM71.description: “I punched an incoming arrow once. It went right through the eye of the archer.”

Vml0CwSMrb1IOmdh.description: “Once had a dryad wanna inhabit my wood if’n ya know what I mean.”

KFUtrIezLYkdWFGK.description: “One time, I beat the mayor in an egg spoon race.”

2hsvhElVZGmQOGkt.description: “I once outdrank a clan of dwarves in a drinking contest.”

3v56zPddxWXDaqEh.description: “I once caught a fish that was TTTTHHHHIIIIISSSSS BIG.”

MfApeRbslQkGfrtU.description: “I got a free go at the land’s most expensive brothel by pretending to be the king.”

RHlngFZaHuBHDb7A.description: “One time I seduced a god. That’s why they weren’t answering your prayers.”

vaeBr1v6HpQVBHpk.description: “I once blew out a fire elemental with a belch.”

4YGo7fBReT089MPs.description: “I once drank an entire water elemental.”

24ULX1AWeqOkq06A.description: “My shadow is actually a Shadow. It does what I want because it’s scared of me.”

MESPuqw6WBnwxtry.description: “Once I was bit by a wererat and it turned into me.”

0TuOgQZHagQh2khk.description: “I once led an army of kobolds.”

933LR7PeAEAHpxsK.description: “I’ve been to the 7th layer of the Abyss.”

898OpPGe6e177pJ1.description: “I once told a riddle so ingenious a Sphinx couldn’t solve it. It killed itself out of shame.”

wjFUcw1F3eVYdZrD.description: “I’m so good at handstands I can do them with two hands tied behind my back!”

IZVGeNGY5qtTOlHN.description: “Grew a beard so rough it beat a mindflayer in a tentacle wrestling contest.”

kUNk9jl49ErdAjSb.description: “Found Vecna’s liver and it’s not done me any wrong since I got it in.”

KbM3CHC4wHj9liOR.description: “I once drank myself free from a bowl of watery death.”

tayb76hbsQvTKAej.description: “I once ambushed a mimic with my disguise.”

X62NzDsjzxVFZvKR.description: “I once threw a minotaur so far, he landed in a different kingdom.”

C3pMf9RztR4u804B.description: “I once cut off all of a hydra’s heads at once.”

G7kIWG9XZQtOYlAz.description: “I once tricked a mimic with a fake adventurer.”

z1tas73l1cRUtka9.description: “I once beat an ettin in a staring contest.”

U5xKZxh16u0mCZlt.description: “Just last week, I ate 100 hard boiled eggs in an hour.”

FQwNS2D8Z9XcdLSA.description: “I once domesticated a displacer beast. Nasty things are impossible to keep track of, so I had to get rid of it.”

7RW5FrlLxJGIei7t.description: “I once defeated a clan of trolls while in the middle of a pie eating contest and still won.”

qbKEdq2trEPQzSDG.description: “I flexed so hard once that the vampire sucking my blood popped.”

Fg5gSV8eZPSrFhBK.description: “I once used all three wishes from a ring to get a nice mutton and lettuce sandwich where the mutton is extra lean.”

1uxTLBPROcPsKQq7.description: “I can dodge a Spear of Backbiting.”

xAk6oRWAJdnCnoXc.description: “I once beat a Medusa in a staring contest!”

ytkhgDZQEn6zlh4O.description: “Drizzt Do’Urden personally gifted me a panther cub to be my familiar.”

ldi0jUxR4SHTgbMw.description: “I once drank a decanter of endless water dry.”

QIiL1ejh3gZiwH22.description: “I once hit an owlbear SOOO hard, it turned into a bearowl.”

VanCa60ESqHI7K77.description: “I beat Asmodeus at dragon chess once.”

UmWfR2mep2zeq9Oj.description: “I killed a man, with THIS THUMB.”

0sipPEIboinVowoU.description: “Lightweight! I once drank a dragon under the table, I’ll have you know!”

ZOgW1zwxL1vL5oxR.description: “I once wrestled a dragon out of the sky.”

lZJ89tQ9x9zyPUwL.description: “I once beat a Beholder in a game of I Spy.”

0VFHMai33Wmq7Bfl.description: “I’ve had, like, 50 heart attacks, and I’m still standing!”

IcWCfkSOwyUmUuWo.description: “I convinced a God to make a star for me, no you can’t see it from here.”

Lt76LlLvJsLslZc8.description: “I once got a standing ovation from (a famous bard).”

XztIuQ2KQkCh1xKL.description: “I convinced (a famous cleric or paladin) to follow me.”

vUUWlkPQhmVURAOQ.description: “I put a suit of armor on a monk.”

bGdfiIR1p7PGD2eI.description: “I spotted (a famous rogue) sneaking around the city.”

tEcRul21rFw1C8PR.description: “I beat (a famous ranger or druid) at hide and seek in the woods.”

4m9JABeiWBdWrkkl.description: “I beat (a famous wizard or scholar) in a trivia competition.”

wY6T82a2hPn95L1G.description: “I cracked a set of adamantine armor.”

r3Rr9wZctqauwGix.description: “I drank everything out of an Alchemy Jug.”

SLWq7DhOP2M93YHn.description: “I exterminated a camp of ogres while wearing armor of vulnerability.”

kBnck1D4De6VDRbt.description: “I found an arrow of me slaying, stabbed myself with it, and didn’t pass out from the pain.”

bNucYGyDYVqyBJEb.description: “I pulled myself out from inside a bag of devouring.”

9fBBCoiHi85MKIxy.description: “I beat out someone wearing boots of speed in a foot race.”

c96kg1SwjX4EDuJd.description: “I held a door closed through a Chime of Opening.”

LEOOEKsjVnc4RRxF.description: “I saw someone wearing a cloak of invisibility.”

iUA4nBzogynDvHnC.description: “I walked through the barrier from a Cube of Force.”

6uI4fsMBdS5X107j.description: “I’ve killed enough dragons to create a a set of Dragon Scale Mail for each dragon type.”

Up9l3uHiEnY2EGAl.description: “I hid from someone using a Gem of Seeing.”

hu4u24H4q4P3eLIS.description: “I beat a Storm Giant in a wrestling match.”

sw0SXee9vNtXYR7n.description: “I won a barfight against someone who had just drank a Potion of Invulnerability.”
